sections.overview: Job Description - Chief of Staff (Business Transformation & Excellence) Location:  Hybrid (with offices in Mumbai, Bangalore, Gurugram) Function: Business Transformation / Strategic Excellence Industry: Consulting / Analytics / Technology
sections.responsibilities:
We are looking for ambitious PGDM graduates to join our Business Transformation & Excellence team - a high-impact function that partners with senior leadership to drive strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and innovation across global clients.
This role is a career-accelerator for future leaders in consulting and business strategy. As Chief of Staff, you will work directly with senior executives, manage enterprise-level priorities, and drive initiatives that transform how Fortune 500 clients operate.
With best-in-industry compensation, leadership exposure, innovation-driven environment, and the opportunity to influence company-wide initiatives, this role is ideal for candidates who aspire to build a career in leadership, corporate strategy, or transformation consulting.

As a Chief of Staff, you will:

• Strategic Transformation: Shape and execute leadership-driven initiatives across business units.

• Governance & Decision Support: Establish structured governance and track leadership priorities to closure.

• Financial & Performance Management: Partner with leadership on financial tracking, margin optimization, and pipeline visibility.

• Leadership Enablement: Act as a thought partner to senior leaders, driving clarity, alignment, and execution.

• Innovation Catalyst: Introduce automation, frameworks, and digital tools that accelerate transformation.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with delivery, finance, HR, and strategy teams to ensure alignment across the enterprise.

• Drive Operational Excellence: Manage and streamline end-to-end operations across multiple clients/business units.

• Resource & Workforce Utilization: Monitor and optimize employee utilization across projects.

• Framework Design & Implementation: Build scalable frameworks that standardize delivery excellence across clients.

What We're Looking For

• Education: PGDM/MBA from a reputed B-School with specialization in Operations, Strategy, Analytics, or General Management.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to structure complex problems.

• High proficiency in Excel/financial modelling; exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or automation tools is a plus.

• Excellent communication and executive presence, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.

• Adaptability, ownership mindset, and ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

• Passion for process improvement, operational excellence, and technology-driven innovation.
Why Join Us?

• Global Impact: Influence how we manage operations for Fortune 500 clients across industries.

• Innovation at Core: Be at the forefront of introducing automation, scalable frameworks, and governance models.

• Best in the Industry Compensation: Rewarding your potential with top-of-market packages.

• Strong Career Launchpad: This role sets the foundation for leadership positions in business operations, consulting, and strategic transformation.

• Direct Leadership Exposure: Work alongside global delivery heads and senior executives.

• Strategic Impact: Influence transformation at the enterprise and client level.

• Innovation Culture: Be at the forefront of governance, automation, and transformation programs.

• Prestige & Opportunity: Position yourself for leadership roles in consulting, strategy, and transformation.

role: Program Manager - Business Analyst (Business Operations & Excellence)

sections.overview: Job Description - Program Manager/Business Analyst (Business Operations & Excellence) Location:  Hybrid (with offices in Mumbai, Bangalore, Gurugram) Function: Business Operations / Program Management / Analytics Industry: Consulting / Analytics / Technology
sections.responsibilities:
We are looking for talented PGDM graduates to join us as Program Managers / Business Analysts in our Business Operations function. This role sits at the intersection of delivery execution, analytics, and stakeholder management, enabling Fortune 500 clients to achieve operational and strategic excellence.
As a Program Manager / BA, you will own programs spanning multiple clients, ensuring delivery governance, financial tracking, resource optimization, and process improvements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve problems, introduce scalable frameworks, and design solutions that enhance business efficiency.
This role is designed for candidates who want to build a career in program management, delivery excellence, and business analysis, with exposure to global clients, senior leaders, and cutting-edge technologies.

As a Program Manager / Business Analyst, you will:

• Program Governance: Set up and manage governance cadences across projects and clients, ensuring delivery quality and compliance.

• Financial & Operational Tracking: Monitor budgets, margins, accruals, and pipeline visibility to support decision-making.

• Project Portfolio Management: Track multiple initiatives across business units, highlighting risks, dependencies, and opportunities.

• Workforce Management: Partner with delivery heads to ensure effective allocation and utilization of resources.

• Data-Driven Insights: Build dashboards, models, and frameworks (using Excel, Tableau, Power BI, etc.) to analyse trends and recommend actions.

• Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for automation and implement innovative tools to improve efficiency.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the link between delivery teams, leadership, and clients - ensuring smooth execution and alignment.

What We're Looking For

• Education: PGDM/MBA from a reputed B-School with specialization in Operations, Strategy, Analytics, or General Management.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking abilities.

• High proficiency in Excel, financial modelling, and program reporting tools; knowledge of BI/automation tools (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, Python, RPA, etc.) is a plus.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong ownership mindset with ability to manage ambiguity and multiple priorities.

• Passion for program governance, delivery excellence, and data-driven decision making.

Why Join Us?

• Multi-Client Exposure: Work across global accounts spanning healthcare, technology, and consulting.

• Strategic Impact: Manage large-scale programs that directly influence client success and internal profitability.

• Cross-Functional Experience: Gain visibility across finance, operations, delivery, and analytics.

• Innovation-Driven Role: Drive automation, introduce scalable reporting, and enhance governance models.

• Career Acceleration: A stepping stone to roles in program management, product management, and consulting.

• Competitive Compensation: Rewarding your potential with top-of-market packages and growth opportunities.

Career Path
High-performing individuals can advance into Senior Program Manager, Business Lead, or Client Partner roles, with opportunities to lead global delivery programs and drive transformation initiatives at scale.

Chrysalis - Capgemini 's B-School Program is a flagship program established in 2011 to attract, hire and develop the best talent from select Management schools of the country. We have several employees at different levels playing critical roles across the organization who have joined through this B-school program that assures high impact roles, leadership visibility, critical business exposure and senior mentor support. Chrysalis hires bring in a fresh perspective and a strong will clubbed with an attitude to build and implement the best-in-class solutions for our clients.

About the Business Unit:
The Insurance practice focuses on delivering technology solutions and services to insurance companies for various lines of insurance such aslife, health, property & casualty, reinsurance, and commercial insurance. Implementing or upgrading policy administration, claims management, billing, and underwriting systems and also connecting legacy systems with modern platforms. Enabling omnichannel customer experiences via mobile apps, portals, and chatbots by Leveraging cloud, APIs, and microservices for agility. Building predictive models for underwriting, pricing, fraud detection, and catastrophe riskusing AI/ML for claims automation and customer insights.
sections.responsibilities:
• The associate would be working as a Business Analyst.

• Coordinate with client's core business and IT teams.

• Capture and manage customer requirements from ideation to production as per the scope of work.

• Resolve domain and requirement related queries.

• Prepare insurance process documents for customer requirements.

• Discussion with onsite/offshore counterparts for clarification of requirements.

• Develop and manage client and stakeholder relationships at all levels in the organization.

• Coach and mentor team members for their professional development.

• Manage the customer requirements using Agile delivery methodologies.

• Stay updated on AI innovations relevant to insurance (e.g., LLMs, NLP, predictive analytics).

• Read industry reports and attend internal knowledge sessions.

• Collaborate with domain experts to define AI use cases

What are the skills/ competencies preferred for this role:

• Excellent understanding of business analysis processes.

• Should have very good communication skills.

• Ability to deal with and decipher the essential details from a variety of information.

• Knowledge of Financial Services organizations with a keen interest in the industry and its future.

• Learning ability to pick up tools and technologies related to various Insurance assignments.

• Good to have a basic knowledge of Insurance Domain and understanding of Insurance Value Chain including Product design, policy admin, claims and billing.

• Attention to detail, organized, analytical & reporting skills

• Must be able to multi-task, deal with ambiguity, work in a team environment, recognize trends and identify systematic approaches to solving problems in this fast moving, dynamic environment.

• Creative and innovative in thinking aligned to business

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving mindset

Job Information*:
Job Code: GADM_02
Job Title: GADM Operations Support
Job Owner: Anand Jani / Amit Sarkar
Business Unit: Global ADM (Global ABL)
Sub BU: ADM GDC INDIA
Function: HUB

About the Business Unit/ SBU/ Project (4-5 lines):
Global ADM (GADM) is a ABL Global entity that is responsible for delivery of offshore heavy Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) services on behalf of BU/MUs. GADM aims to be a best-in-class presales & delivery unit  leveraging an integrated operating model that consistently delivers up a higher CM than sold where deployed.
GADM has been setup to ensure that our ADM teams across the Group benefit from its common operating principles and assets and are set up for success at first in our priority accounts and industries. It is a key step in our journey toward becoming a global leader in ADM services.

What will be the day-to-day responsibilities of the job holder? (8-10 bullet points)

• Understand the essence of the different Global ADM Building Blocks & its business to be able to converse with the leadership on various topics

• Support GADM leadership in preparation for different governance meetings, including building content, driving calls, recording & tracking actions

• Visualize, adapt to the GADM governance review patterns and proactively suggest on improvement areas

• Work in collaboration with Global ADM leaders for developing and monitoring various identified initiatives and actions (and take it to closure)

• Being the integrator identify unforeseen issues / bottlenecks on time and bring it to the notice of GADM leaders to be acted upon and mitigated

• Work with a diverse team across regions / cultures / domains

CHRYSALIS B-School Program (FTE)

We have several employees at different levels playing critical roles across the organization who have joined through this B-school program that assures high impact roles, leadership visibility, critical business exposure and senior mentor support. Chrysalis hires bring in a fresh perspective and a strong will clubbed with an attitude to build and implement the best-in-class solutions for our clients.

What are the skills/ competencies preferred for this role? (6-8 bullet points)

Please Note:
1. Descriptive JD with crisp explanation of the roles and responsibilities is recommended 2. Job Title must be unique, and representative of the role being offered. Avoid using roles available in Capgemini Global Competency Model like As. Con/ Con/ Sr. Con etc. as Job Title

• Proactive

• Ability to coordinate with a diverse set of leadership stakeholders

• High visualization power

• Ability to quickly grasp the context & big picture from different conversations

• Ability to translate topics to high class presentations for leadership stakeholders

• Analytical mindset and solution orientation

Job Title: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Analyst - Credit Bureau Operations Overview The RCA Analyst is responsible for investigating operational, data quality, technology, and process-related issues impacting the accuracy and integrity of credit bureau data and services. This role identifies systemic problems, performs deep-dive root cause analysis, recommends corrective actions, and partners with cross-functional teams to prevent recurrence. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, knowledge of credit bureau processes, and experience working with large datasets.
sections.responsibilities:
1. Root Cause Analysis

• Conduct end-to-end RCA on disputes received at CRIF HIGH Mark. Conduct analysis for data discrepancies, reporting errors, and system issues within credit bureau operations.

• Identify patterns, trends, and recurring issues through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
2. Incident Investigation & Documentation

• Investigate incidents related to credit report accuracy, data ingestion, matching logic, scoring anomalies, and compliance exceptions.

• Create RCA documentation including problem statements, impact summaries, root cause details, and corrective/preventive action plans (CAPA).

• Maintain clear, audit-ready investigation records.

• Prepare presentations and present to respective stakeholders for corrective action.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with data engineering, operations, compliance, product, and technology teams to resolve identified issues.

• Liaise with data furnishers (banks, NBFCs, fintechs) to validate reporting issues and improve data accuracy.

• Provide insights to leadership and stakeholders on risk areas and operational gaps.
4. Corrective Action & Process Improvement

PUBLIC

• Recommend long-term solutions to eliminate recurring data quality issues.

• Track and verify the implementation of corrective actions and ensure effectiveness.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives in credit data reporting, consumer complaint handling, and bureau systems.
5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure RCA outcomes align with regulatory expectations (e.g., RBI, Credit Institutions or equivalent local regulations).

• Identify compliance risks and escalate issues that may impact consumer rights or data integrity.

• Support regulatory audits and internal quality assessments.
sections.qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or related field.

• Experience handling credit bureau disputes or data correction workflows.

• Knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks related to credit reporting.

• Lean Six Sigma certification or training in RCA methodologies (5 Whys, Fishbone, DMAIC).

Role Impact
This position is critical to maintaining the accuracy, fairness, and reliability of credit bureau data, directly influencing consumer trust, compliance posture, and partner relationships.
sections.experience:
• 3-4 years of experience in:
o Root cause analysis
o Credit bureau operations
o Data quality or risk management
sections.skills:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau).

• Understanding of data reporting standards (e.g., CIBIL/Equifax/Experian/CRIF formats).

• Familiarity with scoring models, data ingestion pipelines, and bureau dispute resolution processes.

PUBLIC

• Excellent documentation and communication skills.

• Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple investigations simultaneously.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving.

sections.overview: Customer Strategy & Applied Design
sections.responsibilities:
Customer Strategy and Applied design focused on Strategy & Operations.  The role involves responsibility for leading a discrete work stream or module on a large scale project or overall delivery lead in case of short term/ small scale engagement. The key focus sectors would be TMT and B2C organizations.
For instance, on a front office transformation project for a telecommunication company, one module may be focused on conducting expert interviews and secondary research to understand leading industry practices and processes undertaken by the client, another on gaining a better understanding of clients technology landscape, architecture and customer touchpoints, and a third on developing demand forecasting models. The number of modules varies from case to case and depends on the size of the team and scope of the project.

• Working with internal teams, and clients to develop and implement long term and short-term engagement objectives and work plan

• Ability to understand how business functions operate and how sector trends impact a client's business

• Thinking through a solution lens and working with client and Deloitte's teams to deliver engagements

• Follow applicable consulting frameworks across work modules of the project

• Strong working knowledge of Customer & Marketing Strategy assessment and development

• Data analysis, industry insight generation, design and blueprint of operating models

• Leading small client and internal teams to understand, design, enhance, confirm and deliver objectives of the engagement

• Working in alignment with the internal and client team to ensure a streamlined delivery model with seamless integration of the final deliverable across modules

• Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations

• Effectively prepare business proposals and presentations and assist seniors in responding to client requests, RFPs and problem statements Job Qualifications:
Successful candidates will have a degree from a top-tier MBA, Engineering, BBA or B.Com. Program, with relevant business experience, and the ability to meet each of the following criteria:

• A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting specially in thinking through large and complex engagements

• Background or experience (through coursework or employment) in TMT / B2C organisations

• A base level of knowledge in business strategy, marketing, finance, operations, and data analysis techniques

• Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Leadership qualities, project management skills, and the ability to mentor

• Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently

• Candidates from all academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply

• Willingness for long term international or domestic travel Personal Qualities Valued:

• Passionate in participating and working on complex engagements and opportunities

• Intellectually powerful and agile: curious, rigorous, and creative

Customer Strategy & Applied Design

• Emotionally intelligent: high ability to build strong relationships that inspire openness and trust; to collaborate in teamwork settings with colleagues and clients; and to balance inquiry and advocacy in all personal interactions

• Comfortable with working on difficult issues where there can be no definitive "right" answer; patient in the face of uncertainty, complexity and ambiguity

• Capable of working on multiple, overlapping tasks in a fast-paced environment

• Able to take initiative and make things happen with moderate supervision and guidance

Strategy, Risk & Transactions - RRF: Enterprise Risk - Consultant What impact will you make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration, and high performance. As the undisputed leader in professional services, Deloitte is where you'll find unrivaled opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.
Deloitte is where you'll find unrivaled opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

The Team

The Team Strategy, Risk & Transactions - RRF: Enterprise Risk is a startup within the largest professional services firm in the world. Work you'll do will help organizations solve challenges and navigate business problems. Examples of problems we solve:

•  How do Companies accelerate growth in a risk efficient manner?

•  Assisting Companies help visualize future state operations for eg in warehousing?

•  Sensing risks of the future (like the impact of covid, increase in fuel price and its impact on supply chain and demand, new innovations disrupting traditional business models) to design and develop frameworks to mitigate.
Skills Required
We are looking for curious minds who bring enthusiasm, willingness to learn and an unwavering spirit to question the status quo.
Technical
1. Basic understanding of how businesses function, types of industries and sectors.
Understands concepts like (not comprehensive):
a. Entrepreneurs - what makes them tick. b. Type of profits - gross, net, EBITDA. Etc c.
Supply chain d. Debtors/creditors/inventory etc e. Debits/credits/costing f. Importance of ERPs 2. General understanding of financial statements - P&L, Balance Sheets, Notes to the accounts 3. Helpful if has a basic understanding of emerging technology and its impact on businesses (eg. Blockchain, IoT, ML/AI)

4. Working knowledge of Ms Office Tools
5. Strong math/quant background (will be a plus) 6. Knowledge of descriptive analytics (Tableau, PowerBI etc) tools is a plus Personal/attitude 7. Must be a keen reader (business and non-business) like newspapers, magazines, books, journals.
8. Ability to research and form an independent opinion or provide his / her own perspective 9. Likes to track companies and innovations (will be a plus) 10. Provide value addition - Self-driven with a problem-solving mindset to present solutions and is not afraid to make mistakes whilst doing so.
11. Is not easily flustered in the face of challenges 12. Finisher of tasks - does not procrastinate 13. Clear in communication - write well, speak eloquently and confidently 14. Well-dressed / attired 15. 2-3 years of work experience is a plus Eligibility Education and Experience: 2 years MBA/PGDM (Any specialization)

ROLE TITLE:
Central Research Associate
DIVISION (TEAM):
Project Delivery (Syndicated Research)
REPORTING TO:
Research Manager
CAREER LEVEL:
1

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Research Associate leverages big data, key secondary sources and core research methods to build and validate numbers in a standardized, transparent and efficient way.

DUTIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Extracts non-scalable public domain data such as national statistics and trade data and further develops it for use in data estimates

• Manipulates internal Euromonitor data such as price tracking and digital share of shelf to build granularity into data estimates

• Builds global and regional company profiles to be used in company and brand data calculations

• Works with forecasting specialists to adapt models for regional markets and flags conflicts, validates results against primary research

• Identifies relevant sources and critically evaluates information, recognizes gaps in research and takes logical steps to find the necessary information

• Commissions in-country analysts for targeted primary research to fill information gaps and provide local insights.  Oversees daily management of ICAs, owning the communication, querying and related admin tasks.

• Responsible for data checks throughout data manipulation. Runs quality control and provides detailed explanations on sources and data triangulation and the why behind the numbers.

• Analyses large datasets and manipulates them as needed to create meaningful category/country estimates, as well as monitoring, reviewing, and cleaning up data for internal and external stakeholders, while maintaining records and resolving quality issues

• Provides explanations and defends our research approach to clients when called upon to do so

• Collaborates with local specialists on basic interactions with clients to build and sustain engagement

• Works closely with other teams providing big data inputs, scalable data sources and local insights
sections.skills:
• Curiosity with a passion for learning, problem-solving, and making a difference combined with flexibility, the ability to embrace diversity and be adaptable to change

• Analytical with strong problem-solving skills, process oriented and quick learner

• Team player with a collaborative and transparent approach, capable of working in a global environment

• Proficiency in English (with other languages an advantage), combined with a high level of numeracy and the confidence to engage trade sources for additional insights

• Strong computer literacy, particularly in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with experience of tools such as Power BI and Tableau EUROMONITOR COMPETENCIES The Euromonitor Competency Framework communicates the behaviours that we believe are important for our success, regardless of your area of the business.

sections.location:

About Euromonitor
Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence.
Purpose of the role

• Catalyst is one of Euromonitor's centres for data innovation and scalable solutions. We empower clients and teams to unlock the value of foundational data, making insights accessible, actionable, and impactful across industries. Join us to help shape the future of data-driven decision making. We specialise in areas like dynamic market sizing, digital analytics, web scraping, data visualisation, and process automation.

• As Part of the Foundational Data Group that also includes Analytics, Consumer Insights, Data Science, Data Engineering and Economies & Consumer Analytics, Catalyst has a unified purpose to transform large datasets into actionable insights that are accessible to clients through both syndicated and consulting solutions. We're committed to continuous learning, supporting your growth with mentorship, training, and opportunities to shape your own career path.

• Our work spans industries and geographies, with data and research outputs typically being either multi-country or global. Additionally, there also a great deal of variety in terms of sectors - while the Data Analyst will often be working with the big global FMCG players such as those in Packaged Foods, Consumer Finance, Home & Garden and Packaging, other key clients come from areas such as government and trade associations. As such, work can be business-to-business or consumer focused.
Key accountabilities

• Work hands‐on with large structured/unstructured datasets - clean, organise, transform and validate data using Py /R / advanced Excel or any other analytics tools.

• Build data models and run thorough quality checks across complex, multi‐source datasets.

• Apply data manipulation techniques (e.g., scaling, transformations, harmonisation) to prep datasets for analysis and modelling.

• Analyse data to surface trends, spot inconsistencies and tell clear, compelling stories with numbers.

• Create dashboards, visualisations and presentations that translate data into insights for clients and internal teams.

© Euromonitor International
Page    2

• Ensure data accuracy, structure project files neatly, and maintain high documentation standards.

• Use data frameworks and Catalyst methodologies to support modernised data workflows.

• Present findings confidently to stakeholders, simplifying complexity without losing depth.

• Manage your own workload effectively to meet fast‐moving project timelines.

• Conduct secondary research using reliable websites, databases and industry publications.

• Engage with trade sources and experts to validate assumptions and enrich datasets.

• Gather and review information and strong assumptions to cross‐check, verify and strengthen data accuracy.

• Combine research and data to build well‐rounded market stories for brands, categories and channels.

• Support content creation by contributing to reports, summaries and presentations.

• Learn new skills and ask questions, your growth matters here.
sections.skills:
• Curiosity, critical thinking, problem‐solving, and a strong bias for action.

• Strong command of spreadsheets and large datasets (lookups, pivots, charts, etc.).

• Good understanding of data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio or similar), web scraping, or programming (SQL, Python, R).

• Writing and storytelling (clear structure, headlines, and grammar); ability to summarise insights concisely.

• Teamwork and proactive communication, with the ability to collaborate across time zones.

• Excellent self‐learning ability and comfort navigating steep learning curves.

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (both spoken and written).

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive meaningful conclusions from raw information.

• Confidence and the ability to grow in the role with a strong, forward‐looking mindset.

Nice to have (learn on the job)

• Surveys or mixed-methods research experience.

• Basic understanding of pipelining (and leveraging Git, VMs for this) Basic understanding of CSS selectors and web scraping.

Founded in 1976 as one of India's original IT garage start-ups, HCL Technologies is a next-generation global technology company that helps enterprises reimagine their businesses for the digital age. Our technology products, services and engineering are built on four decades of innovation, with a world-renowned management philosophy, a strong culture of invention and risk-taking, and a relentless focus on customer relationships. With a worldwide network of R&D, innovation labs and delivery centres, and 209,000+ 'Ideapreneurs' working in 52 countries, HCL serves leading enterprises across key industries across the globe. HCL generated consolidated revenues of USD 11.48 billion as of March 31, 2022.
We offer an integrated portfolio of products, solutions, services, and IP through our Mode 1-2-3 strategy built around Digital, IoT, Cloud, Automation, Cybersecurity, Analytics, Infrastructure Management and Engineering Services, amongst others, to help enterprises reimagine their businesses for the digital age.

The company's DNA of grassroots innovation, its ingrained culture of co-innovation, and its tradition of going far beyond what is expected, to create customer value, clearly differentiates it and gives it a distinct advantage in creating value for businesses in the digital and connected world.

WHAT MAKES HCL THE PARTNER OF CHOICE FOR ENTERPRISES IN THE DIGITAL AGE?

Corporate Social Responsibility: HCL builds sustainability principles and actions into the strategy, culture, and day-to-day operations of our company. We aim to improve the lives of people around the planet, engaging our employees, clients, stakeholders, and the communities we live in, to a higher purpose. We focus on areas where we can make the most difference: health, education, technology, jobs, and people who are denied the benefits and access afforded by science, technology, and innovation. Guided by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, we view sustainability in three ways - economic, social, and environmental, known informally as Profit, People and the Planet.

The Corporate Finance Organization is looking for candidates with strong Finance background to drive important financial initiatives and contribute towards the organizational growth. Selected candidates will be aligned to one of the Finance functions (described below) basis profile fitment, specialization, interview performance and business requirements after they are onboarded.

HCLTech Finance Organization Structure

Controllership

The Controller Function is accountable for the accounting operations of the company. It is responsible for the preparation of periodic financial reports, maintenance of an adequate system of accounting records and a comprehensive set of controls designed to mitigate risk of fraud and inaccuracies in accounts, ensuring the accuracy of the company's reported financial results, and ensure that reported results comply with generally accepted accounting principles or international financial reporting standards.

Consolidation (1/7)

• Preparing accurate and timely quarterly and annual consolidated accounts of HCLT group under US GAAP and IGAAP/ IND-AS.

• Regulatory compliances related to financial reporting such as XBRL filings and RBI surveys.

• Controlling and maintenance of group chart of accounts for consistent and efficient reporting.

• Controlling and maintenance of organization structure in SAP and BPC.

• Accounting for corporate actions like Buy Back, acquisitions, Bonus, Dividends.

• Maintenance of exchange rate in SAP and BPC.

• Audit Committee compliance in relation to group auditors and related party transactions.

• SOPs/RCMs review and automation initiatives for controllership and Group Consolidation and reporting.

Legal Entity Financial Reporting (2/7)

• Preparing accurate and timely financials accounts for Parent and each legal entity as per applicable GAAP and getting the same audited.

• Timely and accurate monthly book closure for each entity including doing closing activities which includes:
o Forex revaluation and analysis etc.
o Review of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flows to ensure that accounts are accurate and there are no material errors and profits are maintained as per transfer pricing guidelines.
o Accounting of acquisition specific entries such as upload of non-integrated trial balances, amortization of intangibles, deferred consideration unwinding etc.
o Coordinating with local service providers to prepare the local books and ensuring they are reconciled with SAP, FEMA, OBR and other RBI compliances.
o Inter-company transactions related to investment, share capital, loans and interest thereon.
o Inter-company cost recharges in relation to corporate guarantees and sales cost.
o Wherever separate local books are maintained, reconciliation of the same with books maintained in SAP.
o Compliance of various surveys as per local regulatory requirements.
o Finalization of actuarial assumption for leave and gratuity valuation.
o Supporting consolidation process through filing of disclosures in BPC tool.

Treasury, Derivatives and ESOP accounting (3/7)

• To ensure that derivatives are accurately recorded, documented and audited as per risk management policy of the Company and relevant guidance under US GAAP and Ind AS. Also, to ensure proper exposure management and forex gain (loss) forecasting and validation.

• Accounting for third party loans at group level (other than employees car loans).

• To ensure accurate investment accounting (Fixed deposit. Mutual funds, COD, Bonds) across all entities as per US GAAP and Ind AS requirements and to keep proper documentation, realization

of interest on time, proper TDS accounting on interest income /capital gain and to have them audited as per agreed time schedule.

• To ensure that Options are allotted as per approved grant and documented process and related ESOP cost are accurately recorded, accounted and audited as per US GAAP and Ind AS requirements.

Tax accounting and transfer pricing (4/7)

• To ensure accurate direct tax accounting (current and deferred) in the books of each legal entity based on relevant Income Tax rules. Responsible for maintenance of unit level books of account for each STPI/SEZ units in India.

• Preparation and audit of Tax Audit and Transfer pricing report required for Return filing of Indian entities and providing all information required for filing tax returns. Helping the Corp tax team in tax assessments by providing various required information and implementation of direct tax guidance.

• Helping the Corp tax team in tax assessments by providing various required information and implementation of direct tax guidance.

• Preparation of ETR (effective tax rate) for tax accounting at group level and advance tax projections based on which corporate tax team decides advance tax payments. Calculating and passing entries deferred tax assets and liabilities. Doing analysis of deferred tax assets created on MAT and other DTAs whether it can be utilized in future or not.

Revenue and AR accounting (5/7)

• To ensure timely and Accurate accounting of company revenue as per applicable GAAP (US GAAP, I GAAP) and get the same audited by putting necessary controls and minimize revenue leakages and under / over cost accruals.

• Discussion and concluding revenue recognition issues with auditors and give guidance on revenue recognition to shared services team. There are different aspects to GAAP compliance owing to the service offerings like T&M projects, Fixed price Projects (the accounting can be based on % of completion/planned cost vis-à-vis actual cost), outcome/output-based billing. Infra structure business contracts, multiple services are provided and thus revenue recognition is required through understanding of US GAAP concepts like multiple deliverables, fair value accounting, transition accounting, leases etc.

• To review and analyze Bills Receivables and adequacy of the provisioning. This includes review of provisions based on company policy and case by case review of specific provisions and coordinating audit for Bills receivable. To Give guidance on sale of bills receivables and other assets (Finance lease receivables).

• To review and ensure the correct accounting of other direct costs in line with corresponding Revenue and GAAP. In Depth review at the contract level is required to ensure revenue - cost matching, right classifications and ensure no under or over provisioning.

Merger and Acquisition Accounting (6/7)

• To account for all merger and acquisition including purchase price allocation of consideration paid into goodwill, intangibles and other assets.

• Mapping of acquired entities trial balance with HCL balances so that these can be uploaded in HCL SAP Integration of acquired entities in SAP.

GAAP Guidance on various accounting issues (7/7)

• To review various accounting issues and advice accounting based on applicable accounting GAAP and discussion with auditors if required.

• Implementation of new accounting GAAP like Revenue (ASC 606) and Lease (ASC 842).

Financial Shared Services

Order to Cash (1/8)

• Ensure Timely Closure of Billing as per the monthly close calendar.

• Ensure direct submission of invoices for 98% of the Invoices raised.

• Billed DSO to be below 63 days at the quarter end.

• Unapplied Cash to be below $30M during the quarter end.

• Driving efficiencies, increase Direct Customer Contacts and Portal.

Global Payroll & Employee Reimbursements (2/8)

• Timely and Accurate processing and Payment of Salaries Globally.

• Claims to be processed within 7 working days from date of Business approval.

• Payment and reporting of statutory dues/ compliances within Due Dates.

• Completeness & Accuracy of Monthly Provisions and submit Variance analysis to Controllers.

• Coordinate and close the local Payroll audits Globally.

Transformation (3/8)

• Deployment Artificial Intelligence/BOTs in Finance Operations.

• Drive Automations & process improvement initiatives, deploy interventions across Finance processes with definite outcomes to Achieve.

• Create visibility and transparency by leveraging Dashboards.

• Deploy Benchmarks, Best practices to achieve Best in Class processes.

• Drive Senior Leadership Independent Projects.

Accounts Payable (4/8)

• Payment to Vendors on Time. Enable end to end visibility of Procure to Pay cycle to stakeholders.

• Ensure there are no conflicts of interest and relevant approvals are available as per authority matrix for all payments processed.

Banking (5/8)

• Vendor Payment accuracy - 100%

• Customer Collections Posting.

• Bank Reconciliations to be completed on monthly basis for all 300+ banks.

• Ensure Automated Payment Mechanism to Banks.

Indirect Tax (6/8)

• 100% timely payment of all Indirect Taxes Globally (GST, VAT, Withholding Tax, Sales Tax, Softax).

• Support the Tax team in timely payment and filing of GST return, every month.

Fixed Assets, Campus Bill Verification, Transport & Vendor Master (7/8)

• Timely and accurate capitalization of Fixed Assets.

• Complete Physical verification of assets is completed as per IGAAP and US GAAP requirements.

• Accurate payment of Campus Bills after measurement verification.

• Creation of all Vendor Masters within agreed SLA.

• Ensure Transporters are paid timely and accurately.

PF Trust (8/8)

• Manage the Rs. 2800+ crore PF Trust and recommend investment to CFO and Treasury.

• Ensure PF settlements for Transfer-in and Transfer-outs, withdrawals are processed within 28 days.

• Improve employee experience by responding to employee queries within 48 hours.

Business Finance Cell (3-Pronged Role of BFC)

Enablers

• Enablers to Commercial construct & Contracting prudence.

• To initiate and conclude Commercial Negotiations with the Customer.

• Engages in JVs, purchase of undertaking, facility creation, et al.

• Participates in MVDs, Yellow pad sessions, finance DDs.

• Builds pro-active business cases for a deal pursuit.

Thorough Researcher

• BFC brings to you the present operational and HR realities and challenges.

• Norm based pricing and norms based on existing performance.

• Tracks the complete Macroeconomic changes with respect to currency, inflation, taxation, et al to neutralize the systematic risks across 50+ countries.

• Enablers of key decisions in response to changing commercial trends in the market.

Risk Managers

• BFC is a Risk Manager and focuses primarily on deal wins, balancing HCL's & Customer's financial and legal interests.

• Benchmarks Contracts & Commercials.

• Disseminates the best practices from learnings from large volume of deals.

• Focuses on positioning the intrinsic value of an opportunity to the Senior Leadership.

Strategic (1/4)

• Develop pricing strategies which are competitive and ensures a defined margins threshold for the company.

• Continuous alignment of market driven commercial variables to company defined financial objectives.

Operational (2/4)

• Champion innovative pricing models aligned to the Global Outsourcing Market trends.

• Develop pricing strategies which are competitive and ensures a defined margins threshold for the company.

• Model impact of micro and macro risks inherent to global outsourcing contracts.

• Serve as primary interface for pricing and analytics between the entire finance organization (Taxation, FP&A, Administration, Revenue Assurance, etc.) to the rest of the Organization.

• Direct presentation of pricing strategies before Business Leaders and other Senior Executives in preparation of requisite financial documentation for implementation of pricing decisions.

Key Interactions (3/4)

• Partner with key organization departments to develop, recommend and implement pricing strategies.

• Work with World Class Sourcing Advisors to structure deal commercials.

• Lead front-end commercial negotiation of contracts with Top notch lawyers and Customers on commercial clauses.

Access and Continuous Learning (4/4)

• Access to S&P Capital IQ database to pre-assess the quality of Customers to enable taking long term.

• positions on return on investments.

• Access to in house developed play books and best in class benchmarks to enable market.

• understanding, customer conversations and self-development.

• Ensure the creation and timely upkeep of Standard Operating Procedures for pricing development.

• Manage day-to-activities, training and career development of pricing managers.

Global Business Organization

GBO is responsible for P&L Reporting/Forecasting for over 150+ Leaders in Sales, Delivery, Operations heads, enabling Financial Management, M&A Integration, KPP administration and Biz Analytics dashboard.

• Supporting all Reorg

Pan India / Enabling / Full-Time

We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 222,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis. We, in turn, work hard to bring out the best in them as we strive to help them find their spark and become the best version of themselves that they can be.

If all this sounds like an environment you'll thrive in, then you're in the right place. Join us on our journey in advancing the technological world through innovation and creativity.

Your Role & Responsibilities

The Corporate Finance Organization is looking for candidates with strong Finance background to drive important financial initiatives and contribute towards the organizational growth. Selected candidates will be aligned to one of the Finance functions (described below) basis profile fitment, specialization, interview performance and business requirements after they are onboarded.

HCLTech Finance Organization Structure

Controllership

The Controller Function is accountable for the accounting operations of the company. It is responsible for the preparation of periodic financial reports, maintenance of an adequate system of accounting records and a comprehensive set of controls designed to mitigate risk of fraud and inaccuracies in accounts, ensuring the accuracy of the company's reported financial results, and ensure that reported results comply with generally accepted accounting principles or international financial reporting standards.

Responsibilities

Consolidation (1/7)

• Preparing accurate and timely quarterly and annual consolidated accounts of HCLT group under US GAAP and IGAAP/ IND-AS.

• Regulatory compliances related to financial reporting such as XBRL filings and RBI surveys.

• Controlling and maintenance of group chart of accounts for consistent and efficient reporting.

• Controlling and maintenance of organization structure in SAP and BPC.

• Accounting for corporate actions like Buy Back, acquisitions, Bonus, Dividends.

• Maintenance of exchange rate in SAP and BPC.

• Audit Committee compliance in relation to group auditors and related party transactions.

• SOPs/RCMs review and automation initiatives for controllership and Group Consolidation and reporting.

Legal Entity Financial Reporting (2/7)

• Preparing accurate and timely financials accounts for Parent and each legal entity as per applicable GAAP and getting the same audited.

• Timely and accurate monthly book closure for each entity including doing closing activities which includes:
o Forex revaluation and analysis etc.
o Review of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flows to ensure that accounts are accurate and there are no material errors and profits are maintained as per transfer pricing guidelines.
o Accounting of acquisition specific entries such as upload of non-integrated trial balances, amortization of intangibles, deferred consideration unwinding etc.
o Coordinating with local service providers to prepare the local books and ensuring they are reconciled with SAP, FEMA, OBR and other RBI compliances.
o Inter-company transactions related to investment, share capital, loans and interest thereon.
o Inter-company cost recharges in relation to corporate guarantees and sales cost.
o Wherever separate local books are maintained, reconciliation of the same with books maintained in SAP.
o Compliance of various surveys as per local regulatory requirements.
o Finalization of actuarial assumption for leave and gratuity valuation.
o Supporting consolidation process through filing of disclosures in BPC tool.

Treasury, Derivatives and ESOP accounting (3/7)

• To ensure that derivatives are accurately recorded, documented and audited as per risk management policy of the Company and relevant guidance under US GAAP and Ind AS. Also, to ensure proper exposure management and forex gain (loss) forecasting and validation.

• Accounting for third party loans at group level (other than employees car loans).

• To ensure accurate investment accounting (Fixed deposit. Mutual funds, COD, Bonds) across all entities as per US GAAP and Ind AS requirements and to keep proper documentation, realization

of interest on time, proper TDS accounting on interest income /capital gain and to have them audited as per agreed time schedule.

• To ensure that Options are allotted as per approved grant and documented process and related ESOP cost are accurately recorded, accounted and audited as per US GAAP and Ind AS requirements.

Tax accounting and transfer pricing (4/7)

• To ensure accurate direct tax accounting (current and deferred) in the books of each legal entity based on relevant Income Tax rules. Responsible for maintenance of unit level books of account for each STPI/SEZ units in India.

• Preparation and audit of Tax Audit and Transfer pricing report required for Return filing of Indian entities and providing all information required for filing tax returns. Helping the Corp tax team in tax assessments by providing various required information and implementation of direct tax guidance.

• Helping the Corp tax team in tax assessments by providing various required information and implementation of direct tax guidance.

• Preparation of ETR (effective tax rate) for tax accounting at group level and advance tax projections based on which corporate tax team decides advance tax payments. Calculating and passing entries deferred tax assets and liabilities. Doing analysis of deferred tax assets created on MAT and other DTAs whether it can be utilized in future or not.

Revenue and AR accounting (5/7)

• To ensure timely and Accurate accounting of company revenue as per applicable GAAP (US GAAP, I GAAP) and get the same audited by putting necessary controls and minimize revenue leakages and under / over cost accruals.

• Discussion and concluding revenue recognition issues with auditors and give guidance on revenue recognition to shared services team. There are different aspects to GAAP compliance owing to the service offerings like T&M projects, Fixed price Projects (the accounting can be based on % of completion/planned cost vis-à-vis actual cost), outcome/output-based billing. Infra structure business contracts, multiple services are provided and thus revenue recognition is required through understanding of US GAAP concepts like multiple deliverables, fair value accounting, transition accounting, leases etc.

• To review and analyze Bills Receivables and adequacy of the provisioning. This includes review of provisions based on company policy and case by case review of specific provisions and coordinating audit for Bills receivable. To Give guidance on sale of bills receivables and other assets (Finance lease receivables).

• To review and ensure the correct accounting of other direct costs in line with corresponding Revenue and GAAP. In Depth review at the contract level is required to ensure revenue - cost matching, right classifications and ensure no under or over provisioning.

Merger and Acquisition Accounting (6/7)

• To account for all merger and acquisition including purchase price allocation of consideration paid into goodwill, intangibles and other assets.

• Mapping of acquired entities trial balance with HCL balances so that these can be uploaded in HCL SAP Integration of acquired entities in SAP.

GAAP Guidance on various accounting issues (7/7)

• To review various accounting issues and advice accounting based on applicable accounting GAAP and discussion with auditors if required.

• Implementation of new accounting GAAP like Revenue (ASC 606) and Lease (ASC 842).

Financial Shared Services

Responsibilities

Order to Cash (1/8)

• Ensure Timely Closure of Billing as per the monthly close calendar.

• Ensure direct submission of invoices for 98% of the Invoices raised.

• Billed DSO to be below 63 days at the quarter end.

• Unapplied Cash to be below $30M during the quarter end.

• Driving efficiencies, increase Direct Customer Contacts and Portal.

Global Payroll & Employee Reimbursements (2/8)

• Timely and Accurate processing and Payment of Salaries Globally.

• Claims to be processed within 7 working days from date of Business approval.

• Payment and reporting of statutory dues/ compliances within Due Dates.

• Completeness & Accuracy of Monthly Provisions and submit Variance analysis to Controllers.

• Coordinate and close the local Payroll audits Globally.

Transformation (3/8)

• Deployment Artificial Intelligence/BOTs in Finance Operations.

• Drive Automations & process improvement initiatives, deploy interventions across Finance processes with definite outcomes to Achieve.

• Create visibility and transparency by leveraging Dashboards.

• Deploy Benchmarks, Best practices to achieve Best in Class processes.

• Drive Senior Leadership Independent Projects.

Accounts Payable (4/8)

• Payment to Vendors on Time. Enable end to end visibility of Procure to Pay cycle to stakeholders.

• Ensure there are no conflicts of interest and relevant approvals are available as per authority matrix for all payments processed.

Banking (5/8)

• Vendor Payment accuracy - 100%

• Customer Collections Posting.

• Bank Reconciliations to be completed on monthly basis for all 300+ banks.

• Ensure Automated Payment Mechanism to Banks.

Indirect Tax (6/8)

• 100% timely payment of all Indirect Taxes Globally (GST, VAT, Withholding Tax, Sales Tax, Softax).

• Support the Tax team in timely payment and filing of GST return, every month.

Fixed Assets, Campus Bill Verification, Transport & Vendor Master (7/8)

• Timely and accurate capitalization of Fixed Assets.

• Complete Physical verification of assets is completed as per IGAAP and US GAAP requirements.

• Accurate payment of Campus Bills after measurement verification.

• Creation of all Vendor Masters within agreed SLA.

• Ensure Transporters are paid timely and accurately.

PF Trust (8/8)

• Manage the Rs. 2800+ crore PF Trust and recommend investment to CFO and Treasury.

• Ensure PF settlements for Transfer-in and Transfer-outs, withdrawals are processed within 28 days.

• Improve employee experience by responding to employee queries within 48 hours.

Business Finance Cell (3-Pronged Role of BFC)

Enablers

• Enablers to Commercial construct & Contracting prudence.

• To initiate and conclude Commercial Negotiations with the Customer.

• Engages in JVs, purchase of undertaking, facility creation, et al.

• Participates in MVDs, Yellow pad sessions, finance DDs.

• Builds pro-active business cases for a deal pursuit.

Thorough Researcher

• BFC brings to you the present operational and HR realities and challenges.

• Norm based pricing and norms based on existing performance.

• Tracks the complete Macroeconomic changes with respect to currency, inflation, taxation, et al to neutralize the systematic risks across 50+ countries.

• Enablers of key decisions in response to changing commercial trends in the market.

Risk Managers

• BFC is a Risk Manager and focuses primarily on deal wins, balancing HCL's & Customer's financial and legal interests.

• Benchmarks Contracts & Commercials.

• Disseminates the best practices from learnings from large volume of deals.

• Focuses on positioning the intrinsic value of an opportunity to the Senior Leadership.

Responsibilities

Strategic (1/4)

• Develop pricing strategies which are competitive and ensures a defined margins threshold for the company.

• Continuous alignment of market driven commercial variables to company defined financial objectives.

Operational (2/4)

• Champion innovative pricing models aligned to the Global Outsourcing Market trends.

• Develop pricing strategies which are competitive and ensures a defined margins threshold for the company.

• Model impact of micro and macro risks inherent to global outsourcing contracts.

• Serve as primary interface for pricing and analytics between the entire finance organization (Taxation, FP&A, Administration, Revenue Assurance, etc.) to the rest of the Organization.

• Direct presentation of pricing strategies before Business Leaders and other Senior Executives in preparation of requisite financial documentation for implementation of pricing decisions.

Key Interactions (3/4)

• Partner with key organization departments to develop, recommend and implement pricing strategies.

• Work with World Class Sourcing Advisors to structure deal commercials.

• Lead front-end commercial negotiation of contracts with Top notch lawyers and Customers on commercial clauses.

Access and Continuous Learning (4/4)

• Access to S&P Capital IQ database to pre-assess the quality of Customers to enable taking long term.

• positions on return on investments.

• Access to in house developed play books and best in class benchmarks to enable market.

• understanding, customer conversations and self-development.

• Ensure the creation and timely upkeep of Standard Operating Procedures for pricing development.

• Manage day-to-activities, training and career development of pricing managers.

Global Business Organization

GBO is responsible for P&L Reporting/Forecasting for over 150+ Leaders in Sales, Delivery, Operations heads, enabling Financial Management, M&A Integration, KPP administration and Biz Analytics dashboard.

Process support role (1/7)

• Transaction support

• Data collation / data integrity

• Adhoc data requirements

• Analysis of data

• Operational queries

• Bonus processing

• Capex - Opex approvals

• Daily Order book updation

Decision Support Enabler (2/7)

• Budgetary control

• Billability assurance

• Operational support

Business Partner Role (3/7)

• Contract Monitoring / Mgt.

• PIP improvement

• Budget vs. Forecast. vs. Actual

• Corporate Initiatives

Biz Analytics, Automation & Transformation (BAAT) (4/7)

• SAP BW Management

• Single Version of truth

• Hub for MIS to all systems

• Supporting Automation Initiatives

• Supporting Transformation

• Supporting all Reorg

• Supporting on various Corporate Initiatives either independently or working with LOBs/CEO office/Corp MIS Corp MIS (5/7)

• Consolidation of MIS

• Corporate reporting

• Supporting on various Corporate Initiatives either independently or working with LOBs/CEO office/Corp MIS

• Competitor Analysis

• Deep dive on cost analysis

• Challenge Revenue and P&L Forecast of Lob's Business

• Many Adhoc reports
M&A Integration (6/7)

• SPOC Integration

• Bring and align all finance and business stakeholders to ensure all processes are transitioned well

• Handle any bottle necks

• Support on the GBO role until the business is integrated into the respective Lobs

• Handle Earn Out, monitor the CFO and keep an oversight, front end on any issues.
Enabling (7/7)

• Working closely with all enabling functions

• Capex-Opex monitoring

• Managing a spend of $ 500M per annum

• Analytical reports

• Deep dives spend analysis

• Cost out initiatives

• Cost savings ideas and implementation

Centres for Excellence
Taxation

• Statutory compliance in 50+ countries across the globe.

• Tax Optimization

• Business enabler

• Unlocking idle assets

• Identification and mitigation of tax risks

• Litigation- Corporate Tax & Indirect Tax

• Strengthening tax compliance framework in newer geographies.

• Support to payroll/finance team on payroll taxes M&A HCLTech has done major acquisitions in last few years. We have diversified the portfolio from service company to product company by acquiring IBM products as one of the biggest acquisitions in India.
The work to entail:

• Identification of likely targets in consonance with overall company strategy.

• Finance and legal due diligence of the target companies.

• Handling post-merger and acquisition integration responsibilities which shall include integrating systems, processes, controls, legal compliance frameworks and accounting policies.
Treasury

• Export to multiple countries provides exposure to Forex

• Bank / Cash management worldwide

• Leasing in / out of equipment

• Lending exposure

• Exposure in India Fixed Income Market, India and Global Macro-Economics & Interest    Rate Curve

• Regular interaction with debt market participants

• Managing large size funds in corporate bank or other financial institutions.
Investor Relations and Secretarial

• IR Team acts as front face of HCLTech in dealing with the investors and shareholders.
Legal

• Provides the exposure to both Indian & internal legal compliance framework.
Internal Audit

• Being a large organization, Internal Audit plays a vital role in Company processes and transactions.

• Aid in compliances of internal policies and procedures.

• Conduct periodic audits to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of controls developed in a particular function.

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Requirements

• MBA/PGDM with specialization in Finance (mandatory) and B.Com in UG (mandatory), with minimum 60% across academics (10th, 12th, UG and last semester of PG).

• Relevant work experience would be added advantage.

• Candidates should be open to explore any of these functions listed under the Finance Organization and should not be limited to any specific function.
Desired Qualifications

• You have experience implementing certain strategies.

• You have strong analytical skills and an aptitude for decision-making.

• You show resilience when faced with challenges.

• You believe in continuous learning and growth.

• You possess a strong work ethic.

• You're able to connect with new and existing team members quickly.

• You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the globe.

• You enjoy learning new skills and applying them.

• You are passionate about innovation.

• You want to make an impact.

How You'll Grow

At HCLTech, we offer continuous opportunities for you to find your spark and grow with us. We want you to be happy and satisfied with your role and to really learn what type of work sparks your brilliance the best. Throughout your time with us, we offer transparent communication with senior level employees, learning and career development programs at every level, and opportunities to experiment in different roles or even pivot industries. We believe that you should be in control of your career with unlimited opportunities to find the role that fits you best.

• We work with the biggest brands, offering the opportunity to be a part of industry-leading work.

• We are invested in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark.

• We offer freedom and flexibility on the job, empowering our employees to make decisions.

• We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility.

• Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities.

• We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe.

• We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees.

• We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 17 countries, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect.

Equality & Opportunity for All

As a company with employees representing 165 nationalities across the globe, we pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical disability or genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state, and/or local law.

• Operational efficiency and project performance

• Ensure that the programs and portfolios are aligned to operational and strategic objectives.

• Design and track various program and portfolio performance KPIs

• Forecast capacity vs. demand to identify shortfall or excesses of the resources

• Forecast people on the bench and project vacancies to minimize resource wastage

• Forecast resource management financials to determine the margin and profitability.

• Establish project requesting, selection and prioritization process

• Streamline workflow for resource requisition and allocation within the SA portfolio

• Gathering up to date information about employee skills, interests, experience

• Assign tasks to internal teams and assist with schedule management

• Analyze risks and opportunities

• Act as the point of contact and communicate project status to all participants

• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, plans and reports

• Ensure standards and requirements are met through conducting quality assurance tests

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Requirements

• MBA/PGDM with minimum 60% across academics (10th, 12th, UG and last semester of PG).

• Relevant work experience would be an added advantage.

Desired Qualifications

• Proven work experience as a Project Coordinator or similar role

• Experience in project management, from conception to delivery

• An ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules and step-by-step action plans

• Solid organizational skills, including multitasking and time-management

• Strong client-facing and teamwork skills

• Familiarity with risk management and quality assurance control

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Microsoft Planner

How You'll Grow

At HCLTech, we offer continuous opportunities for you to find your spark and grow with us. We want you to be happy and satisfied with your role and to really learn what type of work sparks your brilliance the best. Throughout your time with us, we offer transparent communication with senior level employees, learning and career development programs at every level, and opportunities to experiment in different roles or even pivot industries. We believe that you should be in control of your career with unlimited opportunities to find the role that fits you best.

Why Us

• We offer End-to-end digital transformation expertise that helps clients from strategy through execution.

• We work with the biggest brands, offering the opportunity to be a part of industry-leading work.

• We are invested in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark.

• We offer freedom and flexibility on the job, empowering our employees to make decisions.

• We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility.

• Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities.

• We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe.

• We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees.

• We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 17 countries, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect.

Equality & Opportunity for All

As a company with employees representing 165 nationalities across the globe, we pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical disability or genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state, and/or local law.

As a Product Manager - Strategy, you will work across diverse product lines such as Personal Loans, Digital Payments, and Channel Management. SKY Global Indian Relationship Manager
Job Title
Sky Global Indian RM
sections.location: Mumbai, Hyderabad and Bangalore
sections.responsibilities:
The Sky Global Indian Relationship Manager will be responsible for acquiring, managing, and deepening relationships with Non-Resident Indian (NRI) clients, offering them customized financial solutions and ensuring superior service delivery. The role involves strategic engagement, cross- selling banking and investment products, and driving profitability for the bank.

• Client Relationship Management & Acquisition: Maintain and deepen relationships with existing NRI customers to increase wallet share. Track NRI visits to India and proactively engage for portfolio reviews. Acquire new NRI clients through referrals and Family Banking.

• Financial Advisory & Cross-Selling: Provide tailored financial solutions including deposits, remittances, care, mutual funds, and wealth management products. Educate clients on regulatory aspects (FEMA guidelines) and market trends.

• Compliance & Service Excellence: Ensure adherence to KYC and FEMA regulations. Maintain accurate client records in CRM and deliver high-quality customer service.
sections.qualifications:
• Mandatory: MBA / PGDM (Preferred specialization: Finance, Marketing, or International Business)

• Desirable: Certifications like AMFI, IRDA, or Wealth Management courses Skills & Attributes

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to strategize, negotiate, and build trust-based relationships.

• Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

Job Description: Consultant - MBA Graduates for Digital Platforms Service Line About KPMG Digital Platforms:
KPMG India's Digital Platforms service line specializes in providing advisory and implementation services across cutting-edge technologies. Our team works with global clients to deliver innovative, technology-driven solutions that drive digital transformation and business excellence.
Role Overview:
As a Consultant in the Digital Platforms service line, you will play a pivotal role in advising and implementing solutions across modern technologies such as .NET, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Adobe, Salesforce, Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and Data Science and Analytics (Python, Machine Learning, AI, GenAI, Power BI, Tableau, etc.). You will leverage your business acumen and technical understanding to provide strategic insights and technology-driven solutions.
sections.responsibilities:
- Advise clients on the best practices for implementing technology-driven solutions.
- Lead development and consulting projects involving platforms like Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, and Adobe.
- Assist clients in their cloud transformation journey, focusing on platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP.
- Provide insights and data-driven recommendations using tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Python.
- Develop strategies to implement AI/ML models and GenAI solutions for business innovation.
- Engage in solution architecture, project management, and stakeholder communication.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies and provide advisory on their adoption and integration.
- Mentor junior team members and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful solutions.
sections.qualifications:
Educational Qualification: MBA graduates from a reputed institution with a background in Finance, Business Analytics, IT, or related fields.
Strong academic performance with a minimum of 60% or equivalent GPA throughout.
sections.skills:
Business Acumen: Strong understanding of business processes and their alignment with technology.
Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with platforms like Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, and Adobe.

Cloud Expertise: Basic to advanced understanding of Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Data Analytics: Proficiency in tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Python for data-driven decision-making.
AI/ML Concepts: Knowledge of Machine Learning, GenAI, and related frameworks is a plus.
Project Management: Ability to lead and manage client engagements effectively.
Soft Skills: Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
- Passion for technology-driven business transformation.

Why Join KPMG India?
Learning and Development: Access to top-tier training programs and certifications.
Growth Opportunities: Work on diverse projects across multiple domains.
Work Environment: Collaborative, inclusive, and technology-driven.
Global Exposure: Engage with global clients and cutting-edge technology initiatives.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates can apply by visiting <link here> Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future with technology!

Job Title: Functional Consultant - SAP (Fresher) Employment Type: Full-Time Department: SAP TE

Job Summary:
We are seeking enthusiastic and motivated fresh graduates to join our SAP team as Functional Consultants. This is an excellent opportunity to kickstart your career with one of the most powerful enterprise platforms in the world and gain hands-on experience in SAP implementations, support, and enhancements across various modules.

As a Functional Consultant in SAP, you will be part of a dynamic team helping businesses streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive innovation using SAP - the global leader in ERP solutions.
SAP powers over 75% of global transaction revenue, serving over 400,000 customers in 180+ countries, including 92% of the Forbes Global 2000 companies. Joining our SAP team means working with cutting-edge technology that shapes the backbone of industries worldwide.
sections.responsibilities:
• Learn and understand SAP functional modules such as MM, SD, PP, PM, QM, FI/CO, or HCM through structured training and mentorship.

• Assist in gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications.

• Support configuration and testing activities under the guidance of senior consultants.

• Participate in SAP implementation and support projects across different business units.

• Document business processes, user manuals, and training materials.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including technical consultants, business users, and project managers.

• Provide post-go-live support and help resolve user issues.
sections.qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Strong academic record and a keen interest in enterprise software and business processes.

• Basic understanding of ERP concepts or exposure to SAP through coursework/internships is a plus.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

• Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
sections.skills:
• Exposure to SAP through academic projects or internships.

• Knowledge of business processes in manufacturing, finance, or supply chain.

• Familiarity with tools like Excel, PowerPoint, and basic SQL.

• Interest in exploring emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Data Analytics, and understanding how they can enhance SAP solutions and business outcomes.

Career Path:
This role offers a clear growth path into specialized SAP consulting roles such as Module Lead, Business Analyst, or Project Manager, with opportunities for certification and international exposure.

Job Title: Business Development Associate Company: NCG Location: Bangalore Experience Required: Level 3 (2-6 Yrs)

Overview: The Business Development Associate will play a critical role in driving the company's growth. Based in Bangalore, this position is ideal for individuals with a passion for sales and client relationship management. The role involves identifying and capitalizing on new business opportunities, thereby contributing to the company's revenue targets. The position requires a proactive approach to sales, excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams. The associate will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment, fostering both personal and professional growth. Our organization seeks a results-oriented Business Development Associate to join our dynamic team. This role is integral to driving business growth and expanding our client base. The associate will be responsible for developing and executing business strategies that align with company goals. A successful candidate will be a strategic thinker with a proven track record in sales and a deep understanding of market trends. As a Business Development Associate, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong client relationships. You will collaborate closely with various departments to ensure the delivery of high-quality services. This role requires a high level of initiative and a strategic mindset to identify and develop new business opportunities.

We are looking for Business Development Associate:

• Identify and generate new business opportunities through cold calling, networking and market research.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing clients to drive business growth.

• Understand client requirements and propose suitable solutions to meet their needs.

• Manage and oversee the complete sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.

• Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets set by the management.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities and client interactions in CRM tools.

• Stay updated with industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments to inform sales strategies.

You Might Be Our Ideal Match If You:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.

• 3-6 years of experience in sales/business development, preferably in the ITES sector.

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

• Self-motivated with a target-driven mindset and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Ability to handle rejection, work under pressure, and maintain a positive attitude.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field
