sections.overview:
The Private Wealth Support Associate Role

•  Each Private Wealth Support Associate partners directly with a team of Wealth Advisors and Client Service Associates in one of AB's 20 US offices that work with high-net-worth clients.

•  PW Support Associates collaborate closely with Client Service Associates, meeting multiple times per week and communicating every day, along with various other departments within Bernstein Private Wealth Management to execute tasks on behalf of clients, maintaining strong communication to deliver seamless client service.

•  Support Associates are responsible for handling the reporting, transactional, administrative, and operational aspects of the client- related work for the practice. These tasks include performance reporting, meeting material preparation, account opening, transfer requests, ongoing account maintenance, account closings, and many other tasks.

•  Given the complexity of client situations, PW Support Associates are required to think critically and navigate nuanced multi-step processes in partnership with other internal teams. This is a dynamic role that requires the ability to multi-task, seamlessly transition between tasks, and constantly think critically to solve complex problems.

•  This exposure to each part of the client life cycle allows for a comprehensive understanding of the wealth management industry and the opportunity to contribute to the success of the practice.
Training Program

•  Private Wealth Support Associates participate in a comprehensive formal training program that is ongoing through their first year working at AB. This program allows Associates to build a foundation of knowledge and develop skills needed to process operational tasks, achieve client service excellence, and fuel success as a financial professional.

•  Associates will spend one week in Onboarding training to learn about basic investment concepts, the Private Wealth industry, and how Bernstein works with clients.

•  Following Onboarding, Associates spend one month in a full-time training program to learn the basic functions of their role. The curriculum includes reporting, account analysis, account opening, and risk assessment.

•  PW Support Associates continue training on the job directly with their team members, with supplemental part-time formal training where they continue to expand upon the functional competencies of the role, covering transactions, servicing of alternative investment products, and wealth planning analyses.

•  On an ongoing basis, PW Support Associates continue to participate in training sessions to dive deeper into investment performance, fees, trust and estate planning, taxes, investment products, and soft skills such as conflict management and presentation skills.

•  AB offers numerous voluntary training programs that allow employees to explore a catalogue of topics such as leadership or technology skills.
Career Development

•  AB is committed to the professional development of its employees. PW Support Associates can expect ongoing engagement and coaching from their manager around their goals, performance, and career progression at AB.

•  While every Associate's career journey is unique, the dynamic nature of the role and the broad variety of work means in the first 2-3 years at AB, Associates focus on working toward mastery of their role.

•  Once a Private Wealth Support Associate has mastered the role, they can pursue the promotion to Senior Private Wealth Support Associate, taking on additional responsibilities of team leadership as an extension of the management team. Senior PW Support Associates will have formal oversight of newer teammates, will guide them through the training program, provide on-the-job training, and QC the workload of new teammates. Senior PW Support Associates display distinctive leadership qualities in addition to possessing excellent procedural knowledge and are viewed as critical resources to the operation and development of the team.

•  After 1-2 years as a Senior PW Support Associate, team members can seek promotions to management roles within the team.
Bernstein's culture is to support and promote talent from within, and we're always looking for dynamic leaders interested in taking on the management of a team, helping to guide other Associates through their learning and development, as well as provide them with the support they need to excel in their career. However, for those interested in learning more about different aspects of AB's business, there are opportunities with other teams across the functions of AB, including Investment & Wealth Strategies, Training & Development, Talent Acquisition, and Analyst roles based in the Pune office. Career paths at AB frequently evolve as new teams are created, making for dynamic careers that allow employees to explore strengths and interests across the business.

About Axtria:
Axtria was founded in 2010 by Jassi Chadha, who recognized the opportunity to satiate the imminent need for data- driven solutions in the life sciences market, to manage the ever-expanding volume of data, driven by rapid digitization and the pervasiveness of cloud technology. The key was to bring enterprise-grade analytics on integrated software technologies that complement the customer's existing ecosystem.
Today, with 3400+ workforce, headquarters in New Jersey and India offices at Gurgaon, NOIDA, Pune, Hyderabad, and Bangalore, we are privileged to provide cutting-edge technology and innovative products to life sciences companies in 75+ countries, helping life sciences organizations transform their product commercialization journey to drive higher product sales and improve operational efficiency and healthcare outcomes.

We are proud to work with 16 of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies. From our roots as a trusted consultant to our status as one of the world's leading providers of cloud-based pharmaceutical management software, Axtria has been powering the digital transformation of life sciences.

Axtria Website: https://www.axtria.com/
Axtria LinkedIn Page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/axtria Profile: Associate/Sr. Associate
sections.responsibilities:
We are looking for MBAs with Tech inclination who want to make a career in Data Science & New Age Technology. If you are passionate about Analytics and want to make an impact by challenging yourself, this is what the role entails:

• Problem solving - Execute complex solutions for defined problems

• Business knowledge - Proactively seek to understand connections between project work and client's business issues. Understanding business requirements. Independently navigate and work with large complex sources of data.

• Implementation of best in class classical and advanced ML approaches in Life Sciences using latest algorithms, Generative AI use cases and ML Operations frameworks using latest tech stack and agile methodologies.

• Technical skills - Good knowledge of techniques, technology & tools for data manipulation, analysis, operations or visualization. Willingness to learn/apply coding skills, where needed. Having hands-on knowledge on SQL/databases and MS Excel is a big plus.

• Communication - Create client-ready collaterals (e.g.: PPTs, reports, story-boarding, documentation) with minimal direction. Effectively communicate with others across the organization, including global team members.

• Cultural fit - Understand and strive to demonstrate Axtria values (Do the RIGHT thing). Actively find ways to support the broader team in achieving objectives. Build trust and respect with stakeholders through quality of work. Proactively support team members

Campus Job Description - AML Operations (AML) About Us At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We're devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Global Business Services
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

sections.location: Bangalore/Remote
sections.about:
We are Cartesian, a 15+ year-old analytics firm. During this time, we've helped some of the largest brands across the globe unlock unprecedented value from their data.

We have now forayed into the SaaS world with our first product SOLUS AI.

SOLUS AI is a System of Intelligence that powers the micro decisions that a brand needs to make to communicate to its customers in a relevant manner. These micro decisions include product recommendations, reasons to talk, words to use, and timing and channel selection at an individual customer level. SOLUS comes pre-built with all the intelligence and expertise to enable this for brands within 4-6 weeks.

SOLUS was inducted into the 2021 cohort of the NASSCOM Deeptech Club and we most recently made it to the top 25 in the TMW100 list in the Product innovation category.

As a company we are obsessed about our people, our processes, our clients, and our commitment to their growth. We expect every single one of our people to display the greatest sense of ownership and pride in the work they do.

We're proud of what we've achieved, and our ambitions are far larger.
What's important for us is not just where we get to, but HOW we get there.
Of course, we don't have all the answers, but our joy comes from the exploration, and that's the kind of team we are.

Role Purpose
Your role is to drive Customer Success, Customer Retention and Expansion Key Responsibilities

• Own ARR and Customer Success targets for SOLUS.

• Identify Customer Success Enablers and best practices for SOLUS.

• Drive exhaustive product module adoption with all clients.

• Managing all customer interactions and act as a voice for the customer to all internal SOLUS teams to enable better customer service.

• Leading the customer success team to build stronger client relationships, speedy resolutions, better adoption and retention.

• Drive high customer satisfaction, own Client NPS and ensure value to the client through SOLUS.

• Use product data to identify accounts that are not fully utilizing the product/likely to churn and proactively work to eliminate risk.

• Commercial Tracking and expansion of product revenue.
Desired Behaviour

• You are a person of your word.

• You believe in the concept of FPR (First Person Responsibility).

• Your first instinct is to find a solution, not to find a suitable slot to lay the blame when something doesn't go according to plan.

• You're not intimidated by hierarchy and experience but also appreciate what you need to do to be able to earn a seat at the table.

• You place a premium on human values as much as financial ones.

• You are Passionate about new technologies.
sections.skills:
•  Previous experience working with clients supporting a CRM/ SaaS Product/ Product tech consulting/product delivery set- up is a plus.

•  Collaboration and partnering with the Sales, Product Development, Tech Support teams to ensure seamless onboarding and management of clients.

•  Strong ability to align technical concepts & features to business needs.
sections.qualifications: B.E./B.Tech + MBA

sections.responsibilities:
This two-year  program offers a unique opportunity to develop:

• Analytical and introduction to leadership skills

• Continuous improvement and risk management mindset

• Collaboration and client-centric behaviors

• Discipline and excellence on execution

• Knowledge in the financial services industry and Operations

• You will get hands-on experience working with teams across Operations to manage processes and services that enables our businesses to deliver an enhanced client experience and reach our goals of reduced risk and efficient operations. About CloudKeeper:

CloudKeeper is a cloud cost optimization partner that combines the power of group buying & commitments management, expert cloud consulting & support, and an enhanced visibility & analytics platform to reduce cloud cost & help businesses maximize the value from AWS & Google Cloud.
A certified AWS Premier Partner, Google Cloud Partner, and FinOps Foundation Premier Member, CloudKeeper has helped 400+ global companies save an average of 20% on their cloud bills, modernize their cloud set-up and maximize value - all while maintaining flexibility and avoiding any long-term commitments or cost.
CloudKeeper hived off from TO THE NEW, a digital technology service company with 2500+ employees and an 8-time GPTW winner.
To know more about CloudKeeper, please visit -  https://www.cloudkeeper.com/ To know more about TO THE NEW, please visit -  https://www.tothenew.com/

Summary:

We are seeking a motivated professional to join the CloudKeeper team to drive lead generation efforts across global markets. The role focuses on identifying qualified opportunities, building meaningful client relationships, and executing targeted outreach through calls and email campaigns. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a passion for uncovering new business potential in the cloud solutions space.

Business Development Manager - Enterprise Sales (Credflow) Location: Noida (Sector 3) Experience: 0-2 years | Fresh MBA graduates welcome Function: Business Development / Sales Openings: Multiple

About Credflow
Credflow is the lending arm of Credflow, focused on building the future of SME financing in India. Our mission is to make Indian SMEs cash-rich by providing seamless working capital solutions such as Purchase Invoice Discounting, Business Loans, and Vendor Financing. We empower businesses to unlock cash flow and scale faster with digital- first credit solutions.

Role Overview
As a Business Development Manager (IC role), you will drive acquisition and growth in enterprise sales for Credflow Capital. The role requires high ownership and a consultative approach, engaging CXOs and decision- makers to expand our lending portfolio.

• Identify & acquire large and mid-sized enterprises (₹100 Cr+ turnover) for working capital lending products

• Present and pitch solutions including Invoice Discounting, Business Loans, and Supply Chain Finance

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with CFOs, Finance Heads, and business owners

• Partner with credit, operations, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth customer conversion

• Manage sales pipeline, track KPIs, and achieve revenue targets

• Share client insights with leadership to influence product and strategy

What We're Looking For

• MBA/PGDM (Sales, Marketing, Finance preferred)

• Strong communication, relationship-building & negotiation skills

• High ownership mindset - thrives in ambiguity, problem-solving, and client-facing scenarios

• Ability to simplify and position complex financial products

• Ambition to grow into leadership roles in enterprise/fintech sales

Why Join Us?

• Work directly with Credflow & Credflow Capital senior leadership

• Fast-track career growth with clear path into Key Account Management or Regional Sales Lead

• Exposure to SME fintech lending, a high-growth sector in India

• Be part of India's SME credit transformation journey

sections.overview:
Role Overview
We are hiring Business Analysts to join our central growth & intelligence pod. You'll work directly with founders, product, operations, and client leadership to translate data into revenue outcomes and shape on-ground strategy across India.
This is not a back-seat analytics role; you'll design hypotheses, run experiments, track execution, measure impact, and scale what works.

What You Will Own
● Deep dive into borrower behavior, portfolio patterns, and DPD workflows to unlock insights that drive recovery uplift.

● Support product intelligence by identifying automation, workflow, and nudging opportunities for Chakra (voice bot), Workflow IQ, LegalTech, and field ops.

● Build and track daily/weekly growth dashboards across portfolios, buckets, and channels (digital / assisted / field / legal).

● Partner with ops leaders across regions (Tirupati, Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, etc.) to improve agent productivity, compliance, and strategy hygiene.

● Run A/B experiments on messaging, campaigns, incentives, and recovery playbooks and quantify the commercial impact.

● Present insights to founders, CXOs of lenders, and internal leadership with clarity, confidence, and data-driven narratives.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique
● You will see the immediate outcome of your decisions; every dashboard spike, every recovery jump will be because of something you triggered.

● You will work on zero-to-one problem statements, not SOP playbooks.

● You will collaborate with data science, engineering, growth, legal, and field ops simultaneously - a rare mix.

● You will grow faster than anywhere else - we move at "Series-A rocketship" speed.
sections.qualifications:
● Fresh graduates from IIMs or Tier-1 MBA programs with strong curiosity and bias for action.

● Excellent with logic, numbers, and structured thinking (SQL/Excel/Python is a plus, not mandatory).

● Ambitious, self-driven, and comfortable with ownership, ambiguity, and steep learning curves.

● Hungry to build - not just analyze.

If You're Someone Who
● Gets excited when you see a broken system begging to be redesigned

● Believes data only matters when it moves revenue

● Wants to be in the room where decisions are made - not after the fact

...then you'll thrive here.

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months
You've designed and executed multiple high-impact growth interventions that improved lender recovery performance, and everyone across the org knows that your insights are not theoretical; they move numbers.
sections.compensation:
● 12L CTC. 8L Fixed + 2L Performance Linked Bonus + upto 1L in Esops + 1L employee linked bonus

● Opportunity to transition into Product / Strategy / Growth Leadership based on performance

Come & join us to build and scale the platform to have at least 100 Banks using it for their application development.
Job Description

The Pre-Sales Manager plays a vital role in Decimal's Sales process. As a PSM, you will be expected to own and engage every step of the sales process from icebreaker meets to sales closure. Ownership of activities is vital and we are looking for dynamic individuals who are self-motivated and demonstrate intent to seize the initiative. It is a high impact, high visibility and very challenging - client facing role that provides ample opportunity to learn & demonstrate new skillsets and expertise.

Key Responsibilities

• Owning end-to-end technical and solutions sales along with the sales team

• Supporting Sales team with handling presales activities from sourcing to deal closure.

• Defining and architecting solutions, delivering product demos, preparing corporate and product offering collaterals, brochures, datasheets, concept videos, client/investor presentations, proposals

• Preparing approach notes, documents, concept notes, business requirement document, technical and functional specifications, proposal.

• Supporting in technical proposal writing, responding to bids/RFI/RFPs

• Market covered - Primary UAE countries. At least 60% of experience in these markets.

• Domain - Banking

• Knowledge of banking regulations and solutions in retail liabilities and assets across GCC

• Exceptional written English documentation skills

12th Floor, Tower B, M3M Urbana Business Park, Sector 67, Gurugram, 122101

• Presentation skills

• Solutions skills

• Willing to work as an individual contributor for next 2 years at least

• RFP management experience

Delhivery is India's leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which includes large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises & brands.

Vision- Since its inception in 2011, Delhivery has become India's leading supply chain services company. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high- quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 40,000+ people strong.

Role Details:
Position: Manager

Department: Fleet Operations

Working Days- 6 Days

About Delhivery:

Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics

operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting India's

logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities.

Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a Fleet Operations manager to manage intracity fleet vendor operations in the West region. The role involves day-to- day fleet management, vendor onboarding & performance tracking, billing oversight, and coordination with local operations, security, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution of transportation needs.
sections.responsibilities:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Dezerv Investments - Management Trainee (Wealth Management) Website | LinkedIn | Podcast Channel | Media Blog About Dezerv India's wealth creators are set to add nearly $1.2 trillion over the next five years, with their wealth growing at a 14% CAGR. At Dezerv, our mission is to support India's affluent and HNIs in their wealth-creation journey. We are disrupting the status quo where HNI portfolios often underperform due to mis-selling and over-diversification. We solve these challenges through customised investment solutions, centrally managed portfolios, and a technology-first approach for superior client experiences.
Scale: As of September 2025, managing over ₹14,000+ Cr in assets (across discretionary and distribution channels), serving clients across 200+ cities, with offices in 5 key locations - Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Pune and Hyderabad, and expanding rapidly.
Clientele: We work primarily with HNI and UHNI clients with portfolios of ₹50L & above.
Investment Solutions: Comprehensive PMS and AIF solutions across listed equity, fixed income, private equity and multi-asset strategies.
Tech-First Culture: We combine deep finance expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver seamless, and personalized wealth management experience. Our proprietary app - Wealth Monitor - currently tracks assets of over 1.5 lakh crore.
sections.responsibilities:
At Dezerv you step into a front-end, client-facing role from day one, bypassing the typical years spent in back-end functions. Your career will immediately focus on core wealth management operating out of Dezerv's office with no requirement for field work. At the same time, your efforts will directly contribute to the firm's growth by bringing in new AUM and building lasting relationships.

Drive Client Acquisition
Strategic Client Guidance: Your primary responsibility is to engage with pre-qualified HNI/UHNI prospects (with portfolios of ₹50L+)  to review their portfolios, understand investment needs, and provide proactive financial insights.
Investment Solutions & Expertise: Leverage your financial knowledge to diagnose and identify pain points in client portfolios. You will be responsible for demonstrating how Dezerv's solutions address client needs, thereby converting prospects into committed clients.
Cross-functional Collaboration: You will collaborate with multiple internal teams to ensure a seamless and high-quality client experience throughout the entire journey.
Drive Client Engagement and Expansion
Client Engagement: Build long term relationships through personalised engagement, proactively sharing market insights and ensuring a seamless client experience.
Portfolio Growth: Review client portfolio and expand wallet share by securing additional capital commitments.
Why Start Your Career at Dezerv
High Ownership & Growth: Dezerv is built for self-starters: take full ownership and make immediate impact. As the firm is at a pivotal moment of expansion, your individual contributions will have a multiplier effect on your long-term career growth.
Merit-based Career Progression: Thrive in a results-driven environment where your efforts directly translate into recognition, rewards, and growth. You have the opportunity to lead your own team in 1-2 years.
Work with Trailblazers: You will be working alongside a team of industry leaders who have successfully scaled businesses and are reshaping India's financial landscape.
Immense Learning Opportunities: You will be immersed in a 2-month training program, a first of its kind in the industry, designed to equip you with real life client experience. A culture of continuous learning ensures you are always evolving to meet the highest demands of the market and yourself. Read more about this program here.
Culture: We foster a culture of open leadership, mutual support, and a steep learning curve. We encourage regular talks with industry experts and offer cross-functional exposure in a collaborative environment where you can truly thrive.

What We're Looking For
Integrity: Consistently act with honesty, and put client interests first.
Humble and Ready to Learn: Mindset of continuous improvement and ambition.
Accountability and initiative: High ownership and committed to delivering impact.
Exceptional communication and the ability to think on the fly: Excellent articulation and client empathy to convey complex financial concepts to any client persona.
Passion for financial markets: An analytical mindset with curiosity in learning financial and Wealth Management concepts.
Educational background: MBA with a major or minor in Finance, or CA/CFA certifications.
sections.location: The initial training (2 months) will be conducted in Bengaluru. Upon successful completion, you may be placed at any of our business locations (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, or Hyderabad), based on business requirements.
sections.compensation:
At Dezerv, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team.
Our rewards policy reflects our commitment to fostering a positive, high-performing culture.
Aligned with our annual performance review cycle, it celebrates individual contributions while encouraging collaboration and continuous growth.
Total CTC: ₹20-24 LPA, depending on performance Fixed Pay: ₹12 Lakhs annually Milestone Bonus: ₹1 Lakh, basis achievement of pre-defined milestones Guaranteed Bonus: ₹1 Lakh, on successful completion of 1 year in this role Performance-Linked Incentives: Opportunity to earn incentives based on performance, with no upper limit. Annual incentives are typically around ₹6 Lakhs for an average performer, with high performers earning around ₹8 Lakhs and top performers around ₹10 Lakhs. Incentives are disbursed on a half-yearly basis post the training period, linked to performance in the respective period.
Comprehensive insurance coverage, including medical insurance of ₹5 Lakhs Generous leave policy: 28 paid leaves annually to ensure a healthy work-life balance

ROLE TITLE:
Central Research Associate
DIVISION (TEAM):
Project Delivery (Syndicated Research)
REPORTING TO:
Research Manager
CAREER LEVEL:
1

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Research Associate leverages big data, key secondary sources and core research methods to build and validate numbers in a standardized, transparent and efficient way.

DUTIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Extracts non-scalable public domain data such as national statistics and trade data and further develops it for use in data estimates

• Manipulates internal Euromonitor data such as price tracking and digital share of shelf to build granularity into data estimates

• Builds global and regional company profiles to be used in company and brand data calculations

• Works with forecasting specialists to adapt models for regional markets and flags conflicts, validates results against primary research

• Identifies relevant sources and critically evaluates information, recognizes gaps in research and takes logical steps to find the necessary information

• Commissions in-country analysts for targeted primary research to fill information gaps and provide local insights.  Oversees daily management of ICAs, owning the communication, querying and related admin tasks.

• Responsible for data checks throughout data manipulation. Runs quality control and provides detailed explanations on sources and data triangulation and the why behind the numbers.

• Analyses large datasets and manipulates them as needed to create meaningful category/country estimates, as well as monitoring, reviewing, and cleaning up data for internal and external stakeholders, while maintaining records and resolving quality issues

• Provides explanations and defends our research approach to clients when called upon to do so

• Collaborates with local specialists on basic interactions with clients to build and sustain engagement

• Works closely with other teams providing big data inputs, scalable data sources and local insights
sections.skills:
• Curiosity with a passion for learning, problem-solving, and making a difference combined with flexibility, the ability to embrace diversity and be adaptable to change

• Analytical with strong problem-solving skills, process oriented and quick learner

• Excellent communicator with good listening skills and an openness to new ideas

• Team player with a collaborative and transparent approach, capable of working in a global environment

• Proficiency in English (with other languages an advantage), combined with a high level of numeracy and the confidence to engage trade sources for additional insights

• Strong computer literacy, particularly in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with experience of tools such as Power BI and Tableau EUROMONITOR COMPETENCIES The Euromonitor Competency Framework communicates the behaviours that we believe are important for our success, regardless of your area of the business.
Our values are the foundation of the framework and the competencies provide focus and clarity on how each of us can bring our values to life in everyday actions to ensure commercial success and true value for our clients.

CURIOSITY
CRITICAL THINKING
Analyses information using structured methods, data driven decisions, asking questions for clarity.
SOLUTIONS FOCUS
Highlights issues or potential problems as they arise, providing solutions for prompt resolution.
CONTINUOUS
IMPROVEMENT
Actively develops knowledge of Euromonitor roles, teams, products and services to deliver better results.

INTEGRITY
ETHICAL CONDUCT
Adheres to ethical standards, policies, processes and guidelines, acting with professionalism.
OPERATIONAL
EFFECTIVENESS

Job specifications:

Consultant - Technology Consulting -
Analytics

At EY, our purpose is to build a better working world for our clients, our people and our communities. We strive to help create a legacy of improved business performance, confidence and trust. Through Performance Improvement service line under business consulting services, we assist our clients' in improving their performance in the core business by delivering measurable and sustainable improvement across various sub solutions - Finance, Customer, Strategy, Operating Model, Digital and People & Organization.

This is a unique team, which designs and implements technology solutions in SCM Transformation programs, Performance Improvements through Analytics, End-to-end Project and Program Management, Enterprise & Business Performance Management (EPM/BPM), and advanced digital competencies such as Robotics & Process Automation (RPA), Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML), Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain among a few of them.

The job role requires a balanced combination of business and domain expertise and ability to map them business requirements and user analytic requirements to IT solutions and help design, develop and configure IT solutions. The candidate will be required to lead IT projects across the domain (Finance / SCM / Robotics / Customer Development) and drive timely closure of projects.

If you don't limit yourself to prescriptive analysis and like to walk the walk by translating advices to reality, you'll enjoy this role. There are opportunities to travel and work with international clients in different geographies as well as laterally move within EY in tune with changing career aspirations. You get to work with a team of youngsters who enjoy their niche.

The opportunity

You will work towards standardizing existing solutions and their work products to be later resourced and leveraged by different teams at EY, demonstrating the ability to digest, incorporate and leverage new knowledge. You will be working with large enterprises and government institutions on their most pressing management and operational challenges.
sections.responsibilities:
► Participate in large scale client engagements and responsible for executing client engagements under the supervision of Seniors.
► Engagements in the areas of IT Supply Chain Management Advisory, IT Project Management, Analytics, EPM, and host of digital competencies

► Contribute to advisory engagements in the capacity of a team member / team leader - deliver quality output within assigned timelines.
► Assist Seniors & Managers in developing new methodologies/models and other related internal initiatives.
► Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
► Continuously strive towards exceeding client & team expectations and work on increasingly complex assignments.
► Conduct research and prepare client presentations, information memorandums and thought leadership documents.
► Attend L&D programs and exhibit through knowledge of advisory methodology and consulting attributes.
► Keep abreast with developments in business related areas and assist team leaders/managers in preparing client decks.
► Sector focus (basic understanding of the industry, trends, issues/challenges & key players) based on the industry group alignment.
► Exhibit initiative and participate in corporate social and team events.
sections.skills:
► Broad consulting and project management skills, effective written and oral communication skills ► Strong problem-solving skills with an analytical bent of mind ► A willingness to travel to meet client needs ► Ability to unravel complex processes and propose simple solutions to senior management.
► Appreciation for IT systems used in different process areas

Development Opportunities:
If you join one of our service lines, you'll be working with leading client organizations, including some of the world's top and most entrepreneurial businesses. If you join us as a member of support services, you'll play a vital role in maintaining the quality of our internal business operations. Whatever path you choose, you'll be encouraged and supported to succeed and to help others to do so too.
We offer a broad range of development opportunities. From day one we'll encourage you to define your aspirations and help you achieve them. We do this through formal training, on-the-job support, coaching, and rewarding challenges that will stretch you and help you grow.
As your career develops, we offer numerous ways to move up, move on or change direction - all within the EY organization. It's important to us that our people are empowered to use their skills and experience in a range of areas, not just across services and sectors but around the world.

To qualify for the role you must have

• A degree in engineering - BE/B. Tech with good academic track record

• Pursuing Masters

• 0-1 year of relevant work experience

Ideally you'll also have

• Strong oral and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building and presentation skills

• Willing to travel extensively (post pandemic)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

What working at EY offers

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

This is a unique team, which designs and implements technology solutions in SCM Transformation programs, Performance Improvements through Analytics, End-to-end Project and Program Management, Enterprise & Business Performance Management (EPM/BPM), and advanced digital competencies such as Robotics & Process Automation (RPA), Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML), Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain among a few of them.

The job role requires a balanced combination of business and domain expertise and ability to map them business requirements and user analytic requirements to IT solutions and help design, develop and configure IT solutions. The candidate will be required to lead IT projects across the domain (Finance / SCM / Robotics / Customer Development) and drive timely closure of projects.

If you don't limit yourself to prescriptive analysis and like to walk the walk by translating advices to reality, you'll enjoy this role. There are opportunities to travel and work with international clients in different geographies as well as laterally move within EY in tune with changing career aspirations. You get to work with a team of youngsters who enjoy their niche.

The opportunity

You will work towards standardizing existing solutions and their work products to be later resourced and leveraged by different teams at EY, demonstrating the ability to digest, incorporate and leverage new knowledge. You will be working with large enterprises and government institutions on their most pressing management and operational challenges.

Your key responsibilities

► Participate in large scale client engagements and responsible for executing client engagements under the supervision of Seniors.
► Engagements in the areas of IT Supply Chain Management Advisory, IT Project Management, Analytics, EPM, and host of digital competencies

► Contribute to advisory engagements in the capacity of a team member / team leader - deliver quality output within assigned timelines.
► Assist Seniors & Managers in developing new methodologies/models and other related internal initiatives.
► Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
► Continuously strive towards exceeding client & team expectations and work on increasingly complex assignments.
► Conduct research and prepare client presentations, information memorandums and thought leadership documents.
► Attend L&D programs and exhibit through knowledge of advisory methodology and consulting attributes.
► Keep abreast with developments in business related areas and assist team leaders/managers in preparing client decks.
► Sector focus (basic understanding of the industry, trends, issues/challenges & key players) based on the industry group alignment.
► Exhibit initiative and participate in corporate social and team events.
Skills and attributes for success

► Broad consulting and project management skills, effective written and oral communication skills ► Strong problem-solving skills with an analytical bent of mind ► A willingness to travel to meet client needs ► Ability to unravel complex processes and propose simple solutions to senior management.
► Appreciation for IT systems used in different process areas

Development Opportunities:
If you join one of our service lines, you'll be working with leading client organizations, including some of the world's top and most entrepreneurial businesses. If you join us as a member of support services, you'll play a vital role in maintaining the quality of our internal business operations. Whatever path you choose, you'll be encouraged and supported to succeed and to help others to do so too.
We offer a broad range of development opportunities. From day one we'll encourage you to define your aspirations and help you achieve them. We do this through formal training, on-the-job support, coaching, and rewarding challenges that will stretch you and help you grow.
As your career develops, we offer numerous ways to move up, move on or change direction - all within the EY organization. It's important to us that our people are empowered to use their skills and experience in a range of areas, not just across services and sectors but around the world.

To qualify for the role you must have

• A degree in engineering - BE/B. Tech with good academic track record

• Pursuing Masters

• 0-1 year of relevant work experience

Ideally you'll also have

• Strong oral and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building and presentation skills

• Willing to travel extensively (post pandemic)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

What working at EY offers

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

candidates on the day of the test. Candidates must write their name and Candidate ID at the top right-hand side of the rough sheet and must handover the same to the Test Officials upon completion of the test. Failure to do so will result in disqualification.

About Geojit Financial Services Ltd.

Geojit Financial Services Ltd. headquartered at Kochi Kerala, is at the forefront of India's financial services landscape for over three decades, offering a wide range of services including equity, mutual funds, insurance, and portfolio management services. Our commitment to innovation, integrity, and customer-centric solutions has helped us grow into a respected name in the industry.
We are at 503 locations across India and GCC countries with more than 15 lakh customers and handle more than a lakh crore of assets under management and custody.
About Geojit Leadership Development Programme (GLDP) GLDP is designed to identify and nurture future leaders. Through this programme, we provide exposure to various facets of the financial services industry to the selected candidates. They gain insights into different financial products and services we offer, through a rigorous training programme and the positions offered is Management Trainee - Wealth.
Management Trainee - Wealth

The candidates who opt for Management Trainee - Wealth will be put exclusively into a sales role in the Private Wealth division of the company where they will be groomed and moulded to be leaders in the Private Wealth space catering to HNI (High Net-Worth Individual) clients and their wealth.
On successful completion of the training period, they will be absorbed in the ranks of the organization as Manager, in the division, at a location best suited. This will be purely on merit and at the discretion of the organisation.

•  Annual Emoluments: ₹10,00,000 per annum (Rs 8.4 Lakhs per annum as fixed component, and Rs.1.6 lakhs per annum - as Long-Term Incentive Plan per year payable six months after confirmation).

•  Continuous learning, certification and development opportunities.

•  A vibrant and dynamic work culture that promotes growth and innovation.

•  In addition to the above, Management Trainees-Wealth will be eligible for incentives based on individual sales performance, as per internal organisational policies.

Management Trainee

Who We Are
Every great journey begins with a small step.
Ours began in 2013, when Mohan Lakhamraju, Arjun Nair, and Hari Krishnan Nair set out with a simple but powerful belief that learning has the power to transform careers, businesses, and lives.
What started as a single Data Science cohort of 28 learners has today evolved into a global learning community of over 13 million professionals, spanning 170+ countries, supported by 8,000+ mentors and faculty from industry and academia.
Over the past decade, we've delivered 490 million+ hours of learning, empowering professionals to move forward with confidence and purpose. Our programs have been consistently ranked among the best in the country, a testament to the quality, rigor, and learner outcomes we stand for.
Our academic partnerships include some of the world's most reputed institutions, such as MIT Professional Education, Johns Hopkins University, The University of Texas at Austin, Northwestern University, Deakin University, IIT Bombay, and Great Lakes Institute of Management, among others.
Every learner who earns a promotion, switches careers, or launches a new venture reminds us why we do what we do. While we take pride in how far we've come, we know the journey of learning never ends, and only gets more exciting.
Mission:
To enable career success in the digital economy through transformational learning experiences.
Learn more: https://www.mygreatlearning.com/about-us "Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn" - Benjamin Franklin

Why Join Us
Education is being reimagined, and Great Learning is helping lead that change.
In just over a decade, we've grown to become one of the most trusted names in professional learning, recognized as the #1 EdTech Startup of 2020. We're driving large-scale change in how the world learns, earns, and evolves, powered by innovation, collaboration, and a shared sense of purpose.
The opportunities are immense:

sections.overview:
As an M&A Analyst, you will be instrumental in driving the organization's growth through strategic transactions such as mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures. This role demands expertise in financial evaluation, rigorous due diligence, and the creation of robust valuation models. You will collaborate across multiple business functions to ensure seamless execution of deals. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Corporate Strategy (M&A Analyst)
sections.responsibilities:
• Build and refine advanced financial models to assess potential deals and investment opportunities.

• Analyze financial statements, operational data, and contractual terms to identify risks and opportunities.

• Investigate industry trends, competitive positioning, and emerging market dynamics to identify strategic targets.

• Track regulatory developments and economic factors influencing M&A activity.

• Generate point of views on internal and external trends

• Streamline key processes of the team through process analysis tools and automation

• Organize ideas into storyboards and present to senior management

• Program managing key organizational initiatives, change initiatives and governance

• Collaborate with other functions in the organization to run key existing processes and establish new processes as required

• Good knowledge and exposure of MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Access, etc.)
sections.qualifications:
•  MBA graduates  (preferably Finance)

•  Prior internship or project experience in consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or strategy is preferred (but not mandatory).
sections.skills:
•  Understanding of financial statements and corporate finance concepts.

•  Thought leadership - articulation

•  Storyboarding & Reporting of Key Performance Indicators - creative thinking

•  Financial Acumen - knowledge of excel

•  Project management - planning & Organizing

Job Title: Junior Analyst - Financial Modeling

About JLL:

We're JLL-a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 91,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That's why we're committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We're using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people and our communities.
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we're honoured to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we're headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of the requirements below.
We're interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

What this job involves:
You will be part of the Investment modeling team that sits within the business line Valuation Advisory.
You will be supporting the business in the form of lease abstraction, financial modeling, Argus modeling.

Passion for real estate
Do you live and breathe real estate financial modeling? After understanding your prospects' real estate needs, you will take the lead in arranging their viewing schedules, analysing the pros and cons of respective options, advising them on the best valuation strategies and seeing those strategies through to ensure maximum results. Working closely with our other brokers and analysts from various global offices, you will put together lease abstracts and financial models for your prospective clients. These will help showcase your financial modeling knowledge.

Hunting for your next success
Does new business light a fire in you? We, too, are just as passionate about growing our portfolio! You will always be searching for your next deal. You'll grow and leverage your network of contacts to ensure you are at the forefront of the market.

Negotiating for the best deal
Are you confident in your negotiation skills? You will need to perform financial analysis and conduct due diligence in order to convince your prospects of your case. Your advice can help them to make a decision between renewing or relocating and the real estate option they choose eventually. Such decisions will shape the real estate footprint of your prospects.

Sound like you?
Inquisitive
Are you interested to acquire more knowledge about the financial modeling and real estate? You will be part of a global business and international team. We are happy to bring on enthusiastic candidates with a flair in developing new business in other real estate asset classes such as residential, retail or industrial spaces and providing them with the opportunity to develop their career.
Team player
While you will be required to work independently while chasing your own leads, we work closely within the global team to service international clients. You can learn from the best brokers in the industry and pick up the market skills required to have know how of your clients' needs in the long run.
Great communicator
Can you put your ideas across to your clients clearly both verbally and in writing? JLL is the leading real estate solutions provider therefore we pride ourselves to be able to present our proposed commercial spaces and negotiated terms clearly to the various stakeholders within our clients' organization.
Excellent communication skill is imperative in this case and you will need to manage your schedule well in order to juggle your existing tenants as well as sourcing for new ones.

To apply you need to be:
Being Analytical
You will be building, maintaining, supporting and validating primary and secondary sources to be used to support our financial modeling assignments. You will also be extracting valuable information from public data sources ranging from macroeconomic trends, industry developments, company financial information and competitor landscape. You will also be involved in data cleaning, preparation, interpretation and analysis using statistical technique and tools in Excel, Internal CRM database and other data management systems.
Meticulous
You must pay attention to detail and have excellent problem-solving skills. Possess the ability to collate information into cohesive presentations with proper slide layout / design.

•  Bachelor's degree in finance, Real Estate, or related disciplines with excellent academic credentials or an equivalent combination of education and experience

•  0-6 months of work experience in real estate industry with proficiency in Rent roll modeling, lease document and financial statement analysis.

•  Proficient in in use of Argus enterprise (with Argus knowledge).

•  Continuously monitor and update property-level financial models to reflect market changes, lease updates, and other pertinent information.

•  Develop accurate and comprehensive financial models using Argus Enterprise software for existing and potential commercial real estate investments.

•  Maintain and enhance the integrity of the Argus database by ensuring accurate property data inputs and ensuring consistency across all models.

•  Outstanding computer orientation and proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and Word software is required.

•  Strong quantitative orientation, with knowledge or ability to learn principles necessary in real estate underwriting, including Discounted Cash Flow, IRR, NPV, Time Value of Money, Return on Equity, Debt Returns, etc.

•  Excellent verbal and written communication skills

•  A desire to work within a diverse, collaborative, and driven professional environment

•  Self-motivating individual who is detail-oriented, has strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently and within a team under deadlines.
sections.qualifications:
You will have a Degree / Diploma or relevant educational background in Real Estate, Business Administration or Accounting & Finance with min 0-6 months of working experience.
You are well verse in Argus Enterprise, excel and real estate financial modeling, and have good communication and writing skill.

Operations Analyst
Deliver accurate, controlled processing, resolve issues, and improve workflows through collaboration and continuous improvement.

Introduction
Build your career in Operations by helping teams deliver accurate, timely outcomes every day. In this role, you will execute core processes with a strong control mindset, partner closely with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve issues, and look for practical ways to reduce risk and improve how work gets done while you learn through onboarding and on-the-job support.

Job summary
As an Operations Analyst in Operations, you deliver accurate, timely processing and help strengthen controls across day-to-day activities. You partner with teammates and cross-functional stakeholders to investigate exceptions, resolve issues, reduce risk, and improve workflows. You contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by using data, sound judgment, and clear communication to drive quality outcomes.
sections.responsibilities:
• Perform day-to-day operational processing with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to documented procedures and controls.

• Monitor workflows and exceptions, investigate root causes, and drive resolution of unresolved items within agreed service levels.

• Follow established control requirements, complete required checks, maintain clear records, and escalate issues promptly using defined governance paths.

• Partner with stakeholders across operations, business, technology, risk, and compliance to resolve issues and improve end-to-end outcomes.

• Prepare and maintain reports and dashboards to track performance, highlight trends, and support ongoing operational reviews.

• Identify opportunities to reduce errors, improve efficiency, and strengthen controls; document process changes and support implementation of sustainable solutions.

• Support changes such as process updates, system enhancements, and control or regulatory updates by helping with testing, documentation, and onboarding support, training, and knowledge sharing.
sections.qualifications:
• Maximum 24 months of professional work experience

• Maximum 12 months gap in education allowed with valid reason

• A well-rounded academic background - minimum attainment of 60% aggregate.

• Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate issues and recommend practical solutions.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver accurate work under deadlines and competing priorities.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and time zones.

• Comfort working with data and common productivity tools (for example, spreadsheets and presentations) and willingness to learn new systems quickly.

• Strong ownership, integrity, and risk awareness, with consistent adherence to process and controls.

• Internship, project, or work experience in operations, process management, finance, risk, technology, or a related field.

• Familiarity with process improvement approaches (for example, Lean or Six Sigma) or experience documenting and improving workflows.

• Experience using operational metrics to identify trends and recommend actions.

• Experience working effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment with defined deadlines and governance.

India-specific and regulatory information The role is based in India. Specific office location and work arrangement will be confirmed during the recruiting process.

Candidates must have authorization to work in India on a permanent basis. JPMorganChase will not provide visa sponsorship for this role.

JPMorganChase is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

If you require reasonable accommodation to apply for a role or to participate in the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter so appropriate arrangements can be made.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work expected for this role.
Responsibilities may change based on business needs and team assignment.

Role: Corporate Sales - Naukri.com

About Info Edge India Ltd

Info Edge is India's leading consumer internet company known for its strong brands in recruitment (naukri.com, naukrigulf.com, iimjobs.com, firstnaukri.com), real estate (99acres.com), matrimony (Jeevansathi.com) and education (shiksha.com).

Starting with a classified recruitment online business, naukri.com, the Company has grown and diversified rapidly, setting benchmarks as a pioneer for others to follow either through setting up of in-house brands or through the route of strategic investments and acquisitions. Zomato.com, policybazaar.com & Happily Unmarried Marketing Private Limited are our investee companies to name a few out of many. With years of experience in the domain, strong cash flow generation, and a diversified business portfolio, Info Edge is one of the very few profitable pure play internet companies in the country.

These are exciting times for Info Edge as we continue to grow in our businesses and scale newer heights.
We are investing across various businesses, especially in cutting-edge technology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI) to increase our predictive powers on customer behavior and continuously optimize and improve our systems.

At Info Edge, people are our core competitive advantage and we will continue doing all that is needed to attract and retain the best available talent. Driven by innovation, an experienced and talented leadership team, and a strong entrepreneurial orientation, we pride ourselves on having a culture that promotes meritocracy. Our numerous milestones can largely be credited to an incredibly smart team working in an environment that encourages creativity and going the extra mile to develop products that people love to use and add value to our clients.

About BU: Naukri.com
Naukri.com, online recruitment classifieds, is a significant player and a market leader in India's well- established business space. The recruitment space provides all the job seekers with advisory services and caters to different elements of the job listing, employer branding, resume short-listing, career site management, and campus recruitment. With over 67 Million resumes searches daily, Naukri.com has 5 Million job listings, 59 Thousand+ more unique clients and 4.9 Million recruiters connect with the job seekers via emails.
The platform, in the online recruitment space, continues to reinforce its established leadership position in India which has given it a competitive edge in the market.

sections.overview:
Role Name: Business Analyst
Role Objective: Business Analyst at Propel is a key player bridging the channel between clients, end users and delivery team. The primary objective of a Business Analyst is to understand the client requirement and business logic. The Business Analyst is also responsible to ensure that the solution meets the client's business needs, quality, and other compliance requirements throughout the delivery cycle
sections.responsibilities:
Client Relationship Management & Consulting:

• Collaborates with the client's business, and tech team to understand, analyse, and prioritize the functional business requirements.

• Prepares and presents proposals and recommendations to key stakeholders by analysing the project scope and requirements.

• Generate opportunities on improvements to achieve the desired business results which are in line with the business requirements.

• Works closely with clients, C-suite, and leadership team (internal & external) in conducting for research, gathering & structing data, deriving insights and recommend solutions.

• Understands data and provides meaningful insights that adds value to business process.

• Works closely with both business and technology teams while learning & building the required expertise/vocabulary to bridge the gaps.

Solution Design & Delivery Management:

• Works closely with clients to gather requirements, define scope and arrive at the solution plan.

• Writes scope proposals, business requirement document, software requirement document as aligned to client requirements, schedules, and budgets.

• Accountable for the maintenance and delivery of all business and technical documents as per the client needs and Propel standards.

• Supports Consulting Directors and Delivery Leads in planning the execution phase of a solution which includes team resource planning, effort planning, timeline, and other estimations.

• Works closely with Creative Director and UX teams for solution protypes and wireframe designs.

• Supports and shadows Architects and Delivery Leads in designing the solution architecture.

• Supervises entire SDLC software analysis, design, development, unit testing and system integration and facilitates towards building reliable and viable solutions.

Team Management:

• Shadows Consulting Directors or Delivery Leads in arriving at effort estimation. Manages project budget by supervising the estimated effort vs actual effort.

• Involves in developing technical skills and application knowledge within the team to enhance core competencies/execute cross training/implement succession plan and ensure adherence to change management process.

• Engages in validating, monitoring, analysing the request, defining the standards, generating the opportunities & evaluating and agreeing on improvements with the concerned teams to achieve the desired business results.

• Nurtures Propel way by actively participating in initiatives and contributes to build psychological safety where the team prioritizes fixing the process rather than trying to 'fix' the person involved.

• Understands the importance of teamwork, enables, and empowers self & fellow team members by identifying training/coaching opportunities or needs.

Requirement:  Excellent Communication Skills, Good Logical Comprehension, Problem Solving Ability, Drive for Results, Leadership Skills, Sound understanding of Microsoft office tools like Excel, PPT, Word.

Values:
Legacy is a bad word in technology, standing still is the same as being outdated. With growing latest trends and digital transformation, we believe in continuously upgrading our skills based on the market needs. Following is Propel's brand fundamentals, and we look for people who share similar values.

sections.location:
Company: Quickclean Laundry Systems

About QuickClean

Quickclean Laundry Systems is one of India's leading institutional laundry infrastructure and operations partners, specializing in end-to-end linen management solutions for the healthcare and hospitality sectors. With a rapidly expanding footprint across 38+ cities, Quickclean partners with some of the country's most respected hospital networks and luxury hotel brands to build and operate world-class laundry ecosystems.
The company pioneered the OPL-BOO (On-Premise Laundry - Build, Own, Operate) model in India, fundamentally transforming how institutions manage laundry infrastructure. By combining engineering expertise, operational excellence, and technology-driven process management, Quickclean enables organizations to achieve international hygiene compliance, operational efficiency, and long-term cost optimization.

Pan India
sections.responsibilities:
We are curating a distinguished cohort of consulting professionals-individuals who combine analytical depth, strategic acumen, and executive presence to influence decisions at the highest levels of enterprise leadership.
As a Senior Manager - Institutional Partnerships, you will operate at the convergence of strategy, operational excellence, and infrastructure transformation, partnering with India's most respected healthcare institutions and luxury hospitality brands. Your role transcends conventional sales or account management; instead, you will function as a trusted strategic advisor, helping organizations rethink and redesign how critical linen hygiene and laundry operations are structured, governed, and optimized.
In this capacity, you will engage directly with CXOs, Facility Directors, and General Managers of premium hospitals and five-star hotels, conducting rigorous operational diagnostics of their existing linen and laundry ecosystems.
Leveraging data analytics, financial modelling, and industry benchmarking, you will architect bespoke, technology- enabled solutions that elevate hygiene standards, unlock operational efficiencies, and generate measurable economic value.
Your work will influence mission-critical infrastructure decisions-each engagement representing a strategic partnership valued at minimum ₹7 Crore (LTV) and beyond. Every mandate therefore carries both strategic significance and transformative potential, positioning you at the forefront of redefining how large institutions manage one of their most critical operational backbones: linen hygiene, compliance, and laundry efficiency.
In essence, this role offers the opportunity to shape industry practices, deliver large-scale operational impact, and build enduring partnerships with some of the most prestigious healthcare and hospitality institutions in the country.

Client Engagement & Consulting
◗ Identify and engage with C-suite leaders and operational decision-makers across premium hospitals and luxury hospitality properties.
◗ Conduct comprehensive operational diagnostics of existing linen management ecosystems.
◗ Translate operational insights into strategic transformation frameworks addressing efficiency, cost optimization, and compliance with global hygiene standards.
◗ Deliver boardroom-ready proposals supported by robust financial modelling, benchmarking insights, and regulatory alignment.

Solution Design & Analytics
Quickclean Laundry Systems | Confidential

◗ Develop financial and operational models quantifying cost savings, productivity gains, and hygiene compliance improvements.
◗ Evaluate the P&L implications of current laundry infrastructure and identify opportunities for operational optimization.
◗ Design performance dashboards and KPI frameworks to track efficiency, quality metrics, and client outcomes.
◗ Benchmark client operations against national and international healthcare and hospitality hygiene standards.

Partnership Development
◗ Serve as the primary strategic interface between the organization and its institutional partners.
◗ Facilitate seamless transition from solution design to operational implementation in collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
◗ Represent the organization at industry forums, hospital administrator networks, and hospitality leadership summits, contributing to thought leadership and business development initiatives.
sections.qualifications: ◗ MBA / PGDM from a Tier-1 / Premium B-School (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, MDI, IMT, and equivalents) ◗ Strong academic record with demonstrated performance in Finance, Strategy, or Operations
sections.skills:

◗ Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging senior leadership with clarity and conviction.
◗ Strong quantitative and financial modelling capabilities, including ROI analysis and P&L interpretation.
◗ Structured problem-solving with the ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable solutions.
◗ High business acumen and situational awareness when interacting with senior stakeholders.
◗ Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to analytics or visualization tools is advantageous.
◗ Naturally curious, intellectually rigorous, and solution-oriented.
◗ Ability to command credibility in executive environments through clarity of thought and articulation.
◗ Highly self-driven professionals who take ownership and thrive in dynamic, high-impact environments.
◗ Comfortable navigating ambiguity and converting complexity into strategic clarity.

In this capacity, you will engage directly with CXOs, Facility Directors, and General Managers of premium hospitals and five-star hotels, conducting rigorous operational diagnostics of their existing linen and laundry ecosystems.
Leveraging data analytics, financial modelling, and industry benchmarking, you will architect bespoke, technology- enabled solutions that elevate hygiene standards, unlock operational efficiencies, and generate measurable economic value.
Your work will influence mission-critical infrastructure decisions-each engagement representing a strategic partnership valued at minimum ₹7 Crore (LTV) and beyond. Every mandate therefore carries both strategic significance and transformative potential, positioning you at the forefront of redefining how large institutions manage one of their most critical operational backbones: linen hygiene, compliance, and laundry efficiency.
In essence, this role offers the opportunity to shape industry practices, deliver large-scale operational impact, and build enduring partnerships with some of the most prestigious healthcare and hospitality institutions in the country.

Client Engagement & Consulting
◗ Identify and engage with C-suite leaders and operational decision-makers across premium hospitals and luxury hospitality properties.
◗ Conduct comprehensive operational diagnostics of existing linen management ecosystems.
◗ Translate operational insights into strategic transformation frameworks addressing efficiency, cost optimization, and compliance with global hygiene standards.
◗ Deliver boardroom-ready proposals supported by robust financial modelling, benchmarking insights, and regulatory alignment.

Solution Design & Analytics
Quickclean Laundry Systems | Confidential

◗ Develop financial and operational models quantifying cost savings, productivity gains, and hygiene compliance improvements.
◗ Evaluate the P&L implications of current laundry infrastructure and identify opportunities for operational optimization.
◗ Design performance dashboards and KPI frameworks to track efficiency, quality metrics, and client outcomes.
◗ Benchmark client operations against national and international healthcare and hospitality hygiene standards.

Partnership Development
◗ Serve as the primary strategic interface between the organization and its institutional partners.
◗ Facilitate seamless transition from solution design to operational implementation in collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
◗ Represent the organization at industry forums, hospital administrator networks, and hospitality leadership summits, contributing to thought leadership and business development initiatives.

Who We Are Looking For

Educational Qualification
◗ MBA / PGDM from a Tier-1 / Premium B-School (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, MDI, IMT, and equivalents) ◗ Strong academic record with demonstrated performance in Finance, Strategy, or Operations

Skills & Competencies
We seek individuals who demonstrate a rare combination of analytical capability, strategic thinking, and executive presence.
◗ Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging senior leadership with clarity and conviction.
◗ Strong quantitative and financial modelling capabilities, including ROI analysis and P&L interpretation.
◗ Structured problem-solving with the ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable solutions.
◗ High business acumen and situational awareness when interacting with senior stakeholders.
◗ Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to analytics or visualization tools is advantageous.
◗ Naturally curious, intellectually rigorous, and solution-oriented.
◗ Ability to command credibility in executive environments through clarity of thought and articulation.
◗ Highly self-driven professionals who take ownership and thrive in dynamic, high-impact environments.
◗ Comfortable navigating ambiguity and converting complexity into strategic clarity.

Experience
◗ 0-2 years of work experience (campus placements in consulting, sales strategy, or operations welcome) ◗ Prior exposure to healthcare or hospitality sectors is advantageous but not mandatory ◗ Internship experience in B2B consulting, solution selling, or operations analytics preferred
