sections.experience:
About Repos - The Mavericks of Fuel-Tech
Welcome to Repos: Fuelling Possibilities, where we don't sell fuel; we sell the future of fuel. Backed by the visionary guidance of the late Ratan Tata sir, we are rewriting the rules of the game.
Fuel doesn't need a petrol pump anymore. It can come to you. It can be smarter. It can be accountable. And we are making that happen.
We are Repos, and we believe in energy distribution for all, with zero wastage. We operate across 380+ cities, hold 12 patents, and have been recognized by PM Narendra Modi & the President of India.
And now, we need you to help us take this revolution forward.

What You'll Be Selling:
Repos Fuel Station (RFS) - Think of it as a petrol pump on wheels. With RFS, businesses can get fuel delivered directly to their doorstep without ever stepping into a fuel station. No wastage, no pilferage-just smart fueling.
Repos Fuelling Datum (RFD) - Data is power, and fuel data is control. RFD is our fuel management system that helps businesses track every drop of fuel in their operations, reducing wastage and improving efficiency.
Your job? To take these game-changing solutions to the right people and show them a smarter way to fuel their business.

Your Role in Fuelling Possibilities
On-Ground Sales & Business Growth

• Own and drive sales in your designated area, selling RFS (mobile fuel stations) or RFD (fuel data management solutions).

• Build a strong network with fleet owners, industries, transporters, and fuel station entrepreneurs.

• Meet clients, understand their needs, and present solutions that fit them best.

• Travel extensively to connect with potential customers and close deals.
Market Exploration & Outreach

• Identify and approach new leads in the fuel and logistics industry.

• Gather insights on industry trends and competitor activities to stay ahead.

• Work closely with internal teams to share market feedback.
Customer Engagement & Relationship Management

• Educate and convince potential customers about the benefits of Repos' solutions.

• Develop long-term relationships with key customers, ensuring repeat business.

• Work towards becoming the go-to expert for customers in your region.
Goal-Oriented Sales Execution

• Achieve and exceed individual sales targets.

• Plan, execute, and optimize your sales approach to maximize conversions.

• Track your sales performance and suggest improvements.

What We're Looking For
sections.skills:
✔ A go-getter mindset-hustle, persistence, and resilience!
✔ Great communication & negotiation skills-convince, close, and conquer.
✔ Passion for meeting people & traveling-this is not a desk job!
✔ Ability to think on your feet-every sale is a new challenge.
Nice-to-Have:
Prior experience in B2B sales, field sales, or business development.
An understanding of industrial fuel needs, logistics, or fleet operations.
Experience in selling capital goods, machinery, or tech-driven solutions.
sections.qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or related fields.
0-5 years of experience (Freshers with fire in their belly-welcome aboard!).

Revolutionary Work - Be part of a company that's changing the fuel industry forever.
Massive Growth Opportunities - Your success isn't limited by time-it's defined by your impact.
Incentives that Matter - The harder you hustle, the bigger your rewards.
Industry Recognition - Work with a brand that's backed by visionaries and celebrated nationally.
"This isn't just sales-it's a chance to transform fuel accessibility in India." Let's fuel possibilities-together!

About Rippling
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds.

Based
in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
We are building a world-class Support team - committed to helping customers realize the full potential of Rippling. Team members focus on getting our customers back on course when challenges arise and contribute to internal discussions around product enhancements. Our Support Organization is composed of product specific teams such as HR, IT and Finance.
If you are the type of person to look at a flight of 10,000 stairs, pause, get a bit excited, and then seize the moment - you have what it takes!

● Take charge of customer issues from start to finish - while working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
● Leverage chat, email, and video conferencing functionality to help our customers optimize Rippling.

● Build mental muscle and become a product expert - you'll be a go to resource for both customers and coworkers.
● Interact directly with Product and Engineering teams to identify areas where we can better serve our customer base through automation or added features.
What you will need
● Bachelor's degree.
● Ability to work a 9-hour shift between 6:30 PM IST - 7:00 AM IST (there may be the opportunity to move to a day shift in the future based on performance and business requirements).
● Demonstrate problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
● Organizational skills and experience improving processes.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
● Flexibility with changing job duties and responsibilities.
● Time management skills and ability to prioritize.
Additional Information
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process.
To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com.

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

sections.overview: Job Title: Customer Success Manager
sections.location:
Full-time Position

About Swym (https://www.getswym.com):
At Swym, we are on a mission to help retail brands craft a truly seamless omni-channel experience for their customers. Fueled by an accelerating shift to online retail, we are on an exciting growth path with over 48,000 merchants across 100+ countries using our products. We work hard as a fully remote team, collaborate async in autonomous fashion, and take ownership of what we do. We operate at a significant global scale, but given the size of the opportunity ahead of us, we are just scratching the surface - there is plenty left to do.

Position Overview:
We are looking for Customer Success Managers who are passionate about onboarding Enterprise customers quickly and efficiently, and ensuring they get the most value from our products. If the opportunity to work directly with thousands of merchants around the globe and help them craft a better shopping experience for their customers gets you excited, this might be just the role for you.
sections.responsibilities:
● Ensure Go-live (TTL) and First Value (TTFV) as quickly as practical:
● Project manage app implementations for Enterprise customers ● Adopt best practices to ensure optimal TTL & TTFV ● Personalize the onboarding experience in line with the customers' objectives ● Opportunistically onboard, consult and demonstrate value for Non-Enterprise customers too ● Develop consistent 2-way engagement with customers:
● Engage with customers proactively & contextually based on merchant health signals ● Maintain a predictable engagement cadence and ensure every touchpoint with the customer has solid value to deliver, backed by data ● Aim to elevate the 2-way customer engagement rate to 100% ● Make the path to Feature Adoption predictable and repeatable:
● Understand the basis and outcomes of the "most valued features" of our products

● Map that understanding to customer objectives and hash out adoption strategies ● Drive valued-feature adoption, and track and benchmark its outcomes ● Build adoption playbooks for different customer segments ● Evolve as a Product Expert:
● Know our product's value proposition and functionalities end-to-end ● Keep up with product-releases by consuming the sign-off release documents ● Lead strategic review & roadmap conversations with your portfolio customers ● Relay product-related feedback and insights proactively to the PLG and Marketing teams ● Swear by Data-led plans of action:
● Dive deep into merchant health data, to familiarize with the patterns of app performance on your merchants' ecommerce sites ● Based on merchant health signals, draw up appropriate engagement / mitigation strategies to maximize value for your customers and control churn ● Help us reach for the stars by setting audacious value maximization targets ● Ensure diligence in Enterprise Customer handovers from Sales:
● Ensure SOPs and coverage of context is followed by the Sales team during account handovers ● Ensure every customer in your portfolio has their customer contracts made accessible on the CRM ● Be a Team-player:
● Collaborate seamlessly with our product, support, marketing, sales & agency partner teams ● Help Sales preempt renewal conversations and make expansion forecasting predictable
sections.qualifications:
● A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or Engineering - An MBA? You're our hero ● 3-5 years of battle-tested experience in Customer-facing roles - Preferably in Customer Success or Customer Support.
● Tech-savvy - You've got a knack for CRM systems (HubSpot) and an affinity for web technologies such as Basic HTML, CSS and JS.
● Genuinely happy about helping people - Seriously, if we could only name one trait that defined success in this role, this would be it.
● A relationship builder - You enjoy building long term relationships with customers to understand their business and help them succeed.
● An excellent communicator - This role requires you to talk to customers regularly, and most of our customers are not India-based. Excellent command of the English language

(both spoken and written) and the skill to tactfully handle difficult conversations is a must.
● Data-driven - You know to analyze and interpret data, and making decisions in that manner is second nature to you.
● Organized - You will work with many customers and on many exciting projects, and you should be able to prioritize and manage time and resources for huge projects ● Strategically minded - You're excited about building a better customer experience from the start by giving feedback on both process and product ● Passionate about what you do and take pride in your work

Our Vibe - What We're All About:
We're a close-knit crew that never forgot our scrappy startup roots. We're exploding with growth, and we're on the hunt for peeps who share our vision for shaping Swym's future.
Our DNA is built on teamwork, personal growth, and striking the perfect work-life balance. We value work, but we cherish life's other adventures too. We're always leveling up, and trust among our team is sacred. Teamwork is our superpower, and we're all about lifting each other up to reach new heights. Our data-driven culture is all about making our customers the heroes of their own stories.
sections.compensation:
● Remote Work: We're a remote-first company, offering flexibility and freedom.
● Time Off: Enjoy 20 days of PTO, 10 sick days, 12 wellness leaves, and 10 fixed holidays.
● Competitive Compensation: Competitive pay and stock options are available for all.
● Health & Fitness: We've got your health covered, including fitness classes for your well-being.
● Employee Wellness & Assistance Program: Your well-being matters. We've got you covered with professional counseling services, because we all need a little help sometimes.

Deal Breakers:
We want to be upfront about what it takes to thrive at Swym:
● Passion for Impact: If you're not passionate about making a real impact on the future of e-commerce, this isn't the right fit.
● Eager to Learn: We expect you to be hungry for knowledge and growth, ready to learn and teach.
● Adaptable & Innovative: We don't do cookie-cutter roles; we need you to embrace ambiguity and redefine your role.
● Challenging Environment: This isn't a laid-back job. It's meant to be one of the most rewarding challenges of your career.

Interview Process:
1. Resume Screening
2. Round 1 - Introductory Questionnaire
3. Round 2 - Panel Call 1 - Introductory Call - 30 minutes 4. Round 3 - Written Assignment + Presentation 5. Round 4 - Panel Call 2 - 45 minutes 6. Round 5 - Panel Call 3 - 45 minutes 7. Round 6 - HR Call - 45 minutes

Conclusion:
The Customer Success role isn't just a job; it's your invitation to be part of an epic journey at Swym ((https://www.getswym.com). You'll be the catalyst behind our journey to greatness, and your impact will be legendary. If you're ready to seize the opportunity of a lifetime and help shape the future of e-commerce, this is your moment!

Success criteria:
1. You've been successfully managing a portfolio of ENT accounts assigned to you, with the core objective of ensuring your customers are consistently deriving value (ROI) from our apps. At any given point in time, it is desired that 80% of your accounts or more, consistently see more than 20X ROI 2. You've been successful at containing churn within your portfolio by maximizing value through feature adoption, reviews and advisory.
3. You've consulted on campaign ideas and playbooks that your customers can deploy using your apps and the integrations you offer, demonstrating the value that such playbooks have to offer.
4. You make decisions everyday based on specific customer health data points such as app actions, website sessions, ROI, revenue, etc.
5. You're aligned with the larger CX team and the org in reducing the time to go live TTL and time to first value TTFV.
6. At any given point in time, at least 80% of your portfolio accounts are engaged with you.
You've mastered the art of fostering two-way customer relationships that are centered in value.

sections.overview:
Business Intelligence (BI) Developer
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers' compensation insurance.

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you're passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients' business success with extraordinary HR.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers.
So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody's perfect - and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.
A Brief Overview
As a member of the Enterprise Data & Analytics team, the Business Intelligence Developer plays a key role in building and delivering high-quality BI solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role works closely with senior team members to translate requirements into dashboards, reports, and data models, while ensuring accuracy, performance, and usability.
While the core focus is on technical delivery, this role increasingly bridges business context and analytics outputs, ensuring that dashboards, reports, and insights accurately reflect underlying business processes and tell the right story.
sections.location: Hyderabad (On-site)
sections.responsibilities:
BI Solution Development & Delivery

• Design and develop dashboards, reports, and semantic models using standard BI tools (e.g., Power BI)

• Translate defined business and technical requirements into intuitive, performant and scalable BI solutions

• Ensure accuracy and consistency of underlying data, KPIs, metrics, and reporting logic across deliverables Data Analysis & Visualization

• Assist in analysing data to model ideal customer profiles, identify key trends, patterns, and insights across business domains.

• Translate data findings into compelling visualisations that aid understanding of complex datasets.

• Support business insights through the development of descriptive and diagnostic reporting, selecting appropriate visualisations to identify trends, variances, and outliers.
Data Modelling & Validation

• Build and maintain intermediate-level data models

• Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks

• Ensure accuracy and reliability of reporting outputs Collaboration with Senior Team Members

• Work closely with senior BI developers, data engineers, and analytics leads to understand solution design

• Execute against technical requirements and contribute to design discussions

• Support integration of BI solutions with upstream data pipelines Business Context Alignment

• Develop understanding of business functions, processes, and key drivers

• Ensure dashboards and reports reflect the correct business narrative and context

• Validate that outputs are not only technically correct, but also meaningful from a business perspective Stakeholder Interaction

• Participate in discussions with business stakeholders for requirement clarification and demos (as required)

• Support translation of business requirements into BI artefacts under guidance Quality, Performance & Governance

• Optimise dashboards for performance and usability

• Adhere to enterprise standards for BI development, visualisation guidelines, documentation practices, data governance and security

• Ensure deliverables meet quality benchmarks with minimal rework

• Stay current with industry trends in BI, visual analytics, and enterprise reporting.
sections.qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field

• Master's Degree with Analytics or Data Science specialization preferred Experience

• Typically up to 2 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data reporting roles

• Hands-on experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)

License and Certifications

• BI Certifications like Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL‐300), Tableau or Looker certifications preferred Skills and Abilities

• Strong SQL and intermediate data modelling skills

• Ability to connect technical outputs with business context

• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking

• Effective communication (especially in structured environments)

• Understanding of data warehousing concepts

• High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Minimal Travel Required

Work Environment

• Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• This position is 100% in office.

Vinculum Solutions is a leading SaaS Omni-Channel Supply Chain software company that helps brands streamline product content, channel listing, order aggregation, and supply chain automation globally. We work with enterprise and SME brands, online marketplaces, distributors, and retailers to drive growth and efficiency in the evolving eCommerce ecosystem.
Our clients include industry leaders like Landmark Group, Titan, Skechers, Pepe, Levis, GMG, Tradeling, Jumbo Electronics, Swiggy Instacart, and Decathlon.
What Vinculum offers:
Seamlessly activate Omni Channel capabilities in stores, franchisees, distributors, or through partnerships with online marketplaces.

• Create content once and effortlessly publish it across diverse sales channels.

• Sell on any webstore, online marketplace, or list on social channels seamlessly

• Manage B-B and B-C Fulfilment of orders from a single module.

• Elevate the customer experience with options like in-store pick-up and returns, nationwide same- day delivery.

• Enable delivery of Online orders from Store or Franchisee or Distributor

• Our Products are enriched with deep functionality, a result of our close collaboration with clients and our ability to anticipate industry trends. Our "Market in a Box" platform seamlessly integrates with sales channels including webstores, online marketplaces, social channels, fulfilment providers such as 3PLs, and last-mile delivery services, as well as select POS, ERP, and financial software.
Founded in 2007, We process 2 million+ orders monthly and extend support to more brands every day to provide a seamless unique experience to customers. We have a record of providing solutions to every customer and high customer satisfaction level.

Primary Purpose of the role
As a Management Trainee at Vinculum Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our global SaaS platform's growth and ensuring our customers derive maximum value. This role requires a blend of functional expertise, strong communication skills, and a keen ability to track and improve product performance.
Key Result Areas :

1. Functional Expertise and Stakeholder Management

•  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.

•  Act as the product SME (Subject Matter Expert) to bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders.

•  Develop and maintain workflows, user stories, and documentation to support the product lifecycle.
2. Onboarding and Training

•  Lead client onboarding and ensure seamless implementation of our SaaS platform.

•  Prepare and deliver training sessions for end-users.

•  Develop templates and SOPs to enhance onboarding efficiency.
3. Global Go-To-Market (GTM) Enablement

•  Partner with GTM teams to design strategies for product rollout across geographies.

•  Customize workflows to align with regional legal, cultural, and business requirements.

•  Support localized marketing and sales enablement initiatives.
4. Tracking Metrics and P&L

•  Define and monitor product KPIs, including usage, adoption, and customer satisfaction.

•  Collaborate with finance to track the product's P&L and recommend strategies for revenue optimization.

•  Develop dashboards to present actionable insights to stakeholders.
5. Continuous Improvement

•  Provide feedback to product teams for roadmap enhancements.

•  Identify and drive innovation to improve customer experience.
6. Compliance and Governance

•  Ensure the product complies with global standards like GDPR, SOC 2, and regional regulations.

sections.location:
For the first six to nine months of joining the work location shall be Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Post successful completion of training the employee shall be permanently based out of Bangalore or Mumbai.
Leadership Group
Venkat Nott - Founder & CEO:
Venkat Nott is experienced in creating startups & building them into successful global companies. He is passionate about creating high power teams & disruptive SaaS products. Through Vinculum, Venkat aims to help 10000 brands to sell online globally across 30+ countries in the next 3 years.
Venkat was recently bestowed with the Retail Leadership Award by Asia Africa GCC Retail Congress.
A sports buff, Venkat has lived in many countries including Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore besides India. He communicates in English and 6 Indian languages, holds a degree in Engineering from NIT Calicut (formerly REC Calicut) and an MBA from Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore.
Annajee Nott - Founder, Vice President - Consulting:
Annajee has over two decades of diverse experience in product engineering and management. He is passionate about SaaS-based product offerings and efficient application of technology to solve business problems.
Annajee manages US operations for Vinculum and plays a key role in overall product strategy and market fit analysis.
Deepak Singla - Co-Founder, Vice President - Omni Channel Retail Deepak has nearly 25 years of extensive experience in consulting CxO executives and global retailers.
He has worked across the supply chain and retail verticals before co-founding Vinculum in 2007. He has got his education from Bangalore University, India and is highly skilled in Retail, CPG & Logistics domains.

▬▬▬  www.vinculumgroup.com▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ Vinculum Solutions Private Limited Plot No.2B, First Floor, Tower 1, Candor TechSpace, Sector-62, Noida, U.P -201307, India He has brought best practices to many retailers, long-term strategies and innovative technologies to help businesses achieve growth & excellence. He is a sought-after speaker in many global industry events.
At Vinculum, he manages key strategic engagements with global retailers and is the backbone in setting up the multichannel software products. He is responsible for business development and strategy for Omnichannel and Master Data Management/ Product Information Management at Vinculum.
Braj Kishore Mahto - Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Braj has extensive experience spanning more than twenty-two years in providing & driving the technological innovations & architectural design directions for the innovation, strategy, and governance of complex businesses and SaaS products. He specializes in tracking technology performance metrics, assessing internal and external impact, and making decisions about the overall direction of the company.
He provides leadership in terms of architecture and technology selections for multiple clients in Amazon Cloud and expertise in leading Cloud Business strategy ideation, cloud initiatives for storage, DR, regulatory reporting, valuation and analytics.
Mandeep Singh Ahuja - Vice President-Product Mandeep is head of Products in Vinculum. He is responsible for developing, coaching, and managing team of product managers and the user experience analysts, defining and driving the product strategy, and instilling Product culture in company. He is working in close co-ordination with other key execs, especially the CEO and CTO.
He has vast experience of 22+ years, in leading end to end Retail Transformation projects in various capacities, and enabled retailers and e-commerce brands to list, sell, fulfil and reconcile across multiple channels. He has insightful knowledge of Business Process Analysis and Solution Design, Process re- engineering, process rationalization, Capacity planning, Performance measurement and quality. He has significant experience working with multiple stakeholders. Highly disciplined professional with excellent interpersonal skills and customer focus with a will to win.
His Domain expertise includes - Food & Grocery, Fresh, Hypermarket, Supermarket, Health & Beauty, Pharmacy, etc.
He has a bachelor's degree in engineering.

Job Title: Summer Intern - Digital Marketing Industry: Out of Home - Airport, City Media, and Metro advertisement space Location: PAN India About TimesOOH:
TimesOOH is a leader in the Out of Home (OOH) advertising industry, specializing in high- impact spaces across airports, city infrastructure, and metro networks. With a focus on innovation, TimesOOH provides advertisers with access to prime digital and physical locations, helping them connect with their audience in meaningful ways.
sections.responsibilities:
1. Digital Campaign Management:
Assist in planning, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, social media, and programmatic advertising.
2. Content Strategy:
Support the creation and curation of engaging content tailored to various digital platforms, including social media posts, blogs, and website updates.
3. SEO & SEM:
Conduct keyword research and implement SEO strategies to enhance website visibility.
Assist in managing SEM campaigns to drive traffic and improve ad performance.
4. Analytics & Reporting:
Track and analyze campaign performance using tools like Google Analytics and provide insights and recommendations for optimizing digital marketing efforts.
5. Social Media Management:
Help manage TimesOOH's social media channels by creating content calendars, scheduling posts, and engaging with the audience.
6. Market Research:
Conduct digital marketing research to identify trends, competitor activities, and new opportunities to engage with the target audience.
Learning & Development:
This internship will provide exposure to real-world digital marketing strategies in the OOH industry. Interns will receive mentorship from experienced professionals and gain hands-on experience with digital marketing tools and techniques.
sections.qualifications:
• Creative and analytical mindset.

• Knowledge of digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social media, etc.).

• Basic proficiency in digital marketing tools like Google Analytics, Ads, and social media platforms.

• Strong communication and writing skills.

• A passion for marketing and staying updated on industry trends.
